generic.Defined scope/population: All externally published brand assets for the quarter, every regulated-product piece plus a 10% sample of the rest.
generic.In-scope period: The completed calendar quarter, using each asset's external publication date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every sampled row carries asset ID, owner, publish date, guideline score and disposition.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled asset count reconciles to the DAM published-asset extract for the quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed audit workbook filed in the compliance evidence repository with audit date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each failing asset carries a correction ticket with owner, due date and a pass, correct or withdraw outcome.
generic.Test population: The full audit sample of external assets scored against the brand guideline checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An asset fails on any retired logo, unapproved mark, expired claim or missing mandatory disclosure.
generic.Exception handling path: Failing assets raise a correction ticket to the asset owner and are re-scored after remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit is accepted when every sampled asset has a score and disposition and no finding is past due.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository, brand compliance audit folder for the quarter.

steps.title: Extract the quarter's published assets from the document management repository
sop: Filter the repository for assets with an external publication date inside the audit quarter.
Export the extract with asset ID, owner, product line, channel and publish date.
Record the total published count as the audit control total.
Done when the published-asset extract for the quarter is saved to the audit folder.
verify: Check the extract date range matches the audit quarter exactly.
Pass when the extract row count is recorded as the audit control total.

steps.title: Select the audit sample in the audit workbook
sop: Include every regulated-product piece in the extract with no sampling applied.
Draw a 10% random sample of the remaining assets using a recorded selection method.
List the selected asset IDs on the audit workbook sample sheet.
Done when the sample sheet lists every asset to be scored.
verify: Confirm no regulated-product asset was excluded by sampling.
Pass when the sample size equals all regulated pieces plus 10% of the remainder.

steps.title: Score each sampled asset against the brand guideline checklist
sop: Check logo lockup and clear space, approved colour values and approved typeface on each asset.
Check the company legal name is the approved form for the entity that published the asset.
Enter a pass or fail against each guideline element in the workbook.
Done when every sampled asset carries a completed guideline score.
verify: Spot-check three scored assets against the published guideline document.
Pass when no sampled asset row is left without a score on every element.

steps.title: Check mandatory disclosures on each sampled asset
sop: Confirm the current legal entity footer appears on each asset.
Confirm the product disclosure line matches the product being advertised.
Confirm the state or licence disclosure is present where the territory requires it.
Done when disclosure checks are recorded for every sampled asset.
verify: Compare two disclosure blocks against the current approved disclosure library.
Pass when no sampled asset is missing a disclosure required for its territory.

steps.title: Raise correction tickets in the document management repository
sop: Flag assets using a retired logo, an expired product claim or an unapproved third-party mark.
Raise a correction ticket against the named asset owner with the specific defect stated.
Set the remediation due date per the finding severity.
Done when every failing asset has an open ticket with an owner and a due date.
verify: Reconcile the count of failed assets to the count of tickets raised.
Pass when no failed asset lacks a correction ticket.

steps.title: File the completed audit sheet in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Record the disposition of pass, correct or withdraw against each asset ID.
Complete the audit summary with sample size, failure rate and open findings.
Upload the workbook to the compliance evidence repository with the audit date and version.
Done when the filed workbook covers every sampled asset.
verify: Open the filed workbook and confirm every asset row shows a disposition.
Pass when no open finding sits past its due date without a documented extension.

steps.title: Review audit findings with the marketing manager in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Walk the failure themes and the repeat-offender asset owners.
Agree the remediation priority and any withdrawal of assets from live surfaces.
Record the agreed actions and owners on the audit summary page.
Done when the manager has signed the audit summary.
verify: Confirm the summary carries the manager name and review date.
Pass when every agreed action has a named owner and target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full brand guideline set covering visual identity, tone of voice and messaging hierarchy.
generic.In-scope period: The guideline edition effective from the publication date until the next scheduled review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, effective date, named approver and change log are present on the guideline document.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logo asset pack file count matches the lockup list stated in the visual identity section.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved guideline PDF and asset pack stored on the brand hub with version and publication timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Review comments not adopted are logged with the rationale for rejection.
generic.Test population: The published guideline document and the logo asset pack on the brand hub.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Publication fails if any mandatory section, the approver name or the effective date is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved compliance comments block publication until cleared by the compliance analyst.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Guidelines are accepted when compliance has signed the disclosure appendix and the version is published.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository brand hub folder holding the guideline PDF and asset pack.

steps.title: Draft the visual identity section in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Document primary and secondary logo lockups with minimum size and clear space rules.
Record hex, CMYK and Pantone values and the approved typefaces.
Define the approved image treatment with do and do not examples.
Done when the visual identity section is complete and reviewable.
verify: Check every stated colour has all three colour space values.
Pass when each lockup shown carries a minimum size and clear space rule.

steps.title: Draft the tone-of-voice section with audience examples
sop: Write the voice principles and the words to use and avoid.
Add do and do not copy examples for consumer, broker and corporate audiences.
Show how the voice flexes for regulated product copy.
Done when each of the three audiences has worked examples.
verify: Confirm no example uses a guarantee or an unqualified superlative.
Pass when all three audiences carry both a do and a do not example.

steps.title: Define the messaging hierarchy
sop: State the master brand claim and the line-of-business propositions beneath it.
List the product proof points that support each proposition.
Mark which claims require documented substantiation before use.
Done when the hierarchy runs from master claim to proof point without gaps.
verify: Trace two proof points up to their proposition and master claim.
Pass when every claim needing substantiation is flagged as such.

steps.title: Compile the mandatory-disclosure and prohibited-language appendix
sop: List the mandatory disclosure blocks by product and jurisdiction.
List the prohibited language including guarantees, superlatives and unsupported comparisons.
Cross-reference each entry to its source obligation.
Done when the appendix covers every product line marketed.
verify: Check the appendix against the current approved disclosure library.
Pass when compliance has signed the appendix ahead of publication.

steps.title: Circulate the draft for review and log responses
sop: Send the draft to product, distribution and compliance with a response deadline.
Log every comment with its disposition of adopted, rejected or deferred.
Record the rationale for each rejected comment.
Done when no comment is left without a disposition.
verify: Count comments received against comments dispositioned.
Pass when the review log shows a disposition for every comment.

steps.title: Publish the approved guideline and asset pack to the brand hub
sop: Apply the version number, effective date and named approver to the document.
Upload the guideline PDF and logo asset pack to the document management repository brand hub.
Archive the superseded version so it is no longer downloadable.
Done when the new version is the only one marked current.
verify: Search the brand hub for prior versions still marked current.
Pass when no superseded guideline version is downloadable from the hub.

steps.title: Announce the new version to the marketing channel
sop: Post the version note listing what changed and what must be reworked.
State the date from which the previous version may no longer be used.
Link the guideline and asset pack locations.
Done when the version note is posted to the marketing channel.
verify: Confirm the note names the effective date and the affected asset types.
Pass when the posted note links to the current published version only.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customers, prospects and appointed producers sampled for the annual brand perception tracker wave.
generic.In-scope period: The current tracker wave fielding window with the prior wave held for comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every response row carries segment code, weight, wave identifier and completion status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Completes per segment reconcile to the quota targets set for the wave.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Wave dataset and deck stored with fielding dates, questionnaire version and load timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questionnaire changes from the prior wave are logged with their impact on trend comparability.
generic.Test population: The fielded invitation file and the weighted response set for the current wave.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The wave fails if any segment closes below its minimum quota or weights do not sum to the frame.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments short of quota are boosted or extended before analysis rather than reported as final.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Wave is accepted when quotas are met, weights validate and the deck states trend comparability.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint brand tracker folder holding the wave dataset, deck and sample frames.

steps.title: Confirm the questionnaire version against the prior wave
sop: Compare the current questionnaire item by item against the prior wave.
Log every changed, added or removed item in the change register.
State the comparability impact of each change for the report.
Done when the questionnaire is locked with its change log.
verify: Check the change log covers every difference found in the comparison.
Pass when the locked questionnaire version is recorded on the wave record.

steps.title: Build the three sample frames in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Select the customer, prospect and appointed producer frames from the governed marts.
Apply the eligibility rules for each frame and record the counts.
Reconcile each frame count to the query control totals.
Done when the three frames are built with recorded counts.
verify: Re-run the frame queries and compare the counts.
Pass when each frame count matches its recorded control total.

steps.title: Apply marketing opt-out suppression to the invitation file
sop: Join the frames to the current marketing opt-out and do-not-contact sources.
Remove every suppressed contact and record the count removed per rule.
Release the invitation file only after suppression has run.
Done when the invitation file is produced post-suppression.
verify: Sample the invitation file against the opt-out source.
Pass when no contact on the marketing opt-out list appears in the invitation file.

steps.title: Field the survey and monitor completes against quota
sop: Launch fielding on the agreed dates and record the launch timestamp.
Track completes daily by segment against the quota targets.
Boost or extend only the segments running short of quota.
Done when every segment has reached its quota or a documented stop decision.
verify: Review the daily completes report at close of fielding.
Pass when no segment closed below quota without a recorded decision.

steps.title: Weight responses and calculate the tracker metrics
sop: Weight the responses to the agreed segment mix and check the weights sum to the frame.
Calculate unaided awareness, aided awareness, favourability and consideration.
Compare each metric against the prior wave and test the differences.
Done when all four metrics are calculated with prior-wave comparison.
verify: Recompute one metric from the raw responses as a check.
Pass when weighted totals reconcile to the frame sizes.

steps.title: Code the open-text verbatims into themes
sop: Apply the existing theme codeframe to the verbatims and add new themes where needed.
Have a second coder check a sample for consistency.
Summarise the theme volumes and the notable quotes.
Done when every verbatim carries a theme code.
verify: Check the double-coded sample for coder agreement.
Pass when no verbatim is left uncoded in the wave file.

steps.title: Deliver the wave deck to marketing leadership
sop: Build the deck with wave-on-wave deltas and flag the significant movements.
State the questionnaire changes and their comparability impact.
Circulate the deck to the marketing manager and the leadership list.
Done when the deck is issued and filed to the tracker folder.
verify: Confirm every flagged delta carries its significance result.
Pass when the deck is filed with the wave dataset and fielding dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every named target customer segment requiring a brand positioning statement and value proposition.
generic.In-scope period: The current planning cycle, refreshed when segment definitions or tracker evidence change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each statement carries target, frame of reference, point of difference and reason to believe.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of positioning statements matches the count of named target segments.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Positioning pack stored on the brand hub with version, approval date and evidence attachments.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments left without an agreed proposition are logged with the reason and a revisit date.
generic.Test population: All published positioning statements and their attached evidence sources.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A statement fails if any point-of-difference claim has no attached evidence source.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsubstantiated claims are removed or reworded before the pack is published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Positioning is accepted when product and distribution confirm no conflicting propositions exist.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository brand hub folder holding the approved positioning pack.

steps.title: Pull segment definitions and share figures from the BI/reporting platform
sop: Export the current segment definitions and their attribute criteria.
Pull share and penetration figures for each target segment.
Record the reporting period and the dataset used.
Done when the segment fact base is assembled for every target segment.
verify: Check the segment list against the approved segmentation model.
Pass when each target segment has a recorded share and penetration figure.

steps.title: Write the positioning statement for each segment
sop: Use the standard frame of target, frame of reference, point of difference and reason to believe.
Write one statement per segment with no borrowed wording between segments.
Keep claims specific enough to be tested against evidence.
Done when every named segment has a drafted statement.
verify: Count drafted statements against named target segments.
Pass when no segment is left without a statement in the standard frame.

steps.title: Attach supporting evidence to every point-of-difference claim
sop: Link tracker data, win and loss analysis or customer research to each claim.
Record the source, date and owner of each evidence item.
Reject or reword any claim with no available evidence.
Done when every point-of-difference claim carries a named source.
verify: Sample three claims and open their evidence sources.
Pass when no published claim lacks a documented evidence source.

steps.title: Review the segment set with product and distribution leads
sop: Circulate the draft statements to the product and distribution leads.
Check for two segments carrying conflicting or overlapping propositions.
Resolve conflicts by amending one statement and logging the change.
Done when the leads confirm no conflicting propositions remain.
verify: Compare propositions across adjacent segments for contradiction.
Pass when the review log records confirmation from both leads.

steps.title: Publish the approved positioning pack to the brand hub
sop: Assemble the pack with statements, evidence references and approval details.
Apply the version number and approval date.
Upload to the document management repository brand hub and archive the prior version.
Done when the current pack is the only version marked live.
verify: Search the hub for superseded packs still marked current.
Pass when only the approved version is available to download.

steps.title: Update the messaging hierarchy in the brand guidelines
sop: Map each segment proposition into the brand guideline messaging hierarchy.
Update the proof points to match the newly evidenced claims.
Issue the guideline change note to the marketing channel.
Done when the hierarchy reflects the approved positioning.
verify: Compare the hierarchy entries against the approved statements.
Pass when no hierarchy entry contradicts the published positioning.

steps.title: Confirm segment coverage and log gaps
sop: Reconcile positioning statements to the full target segment list.
Log any segment without an agreed proposition and the reason.
Set a revisit date for each logged gap.
Done when every gap is logged with an owner and a revisit date.
verify: Check the gap log against the segment list.
Pass when the count of statements plus logged gaps equals the segment count.

generic.Defined scope/population: All incoming brand extension and partner co-branding requests received in the review period.
generic.In-scope period: The current review period, with approvals valid only to their recorded expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each request records requesting party, proposed use, channel, duration and territories.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requests logged reconcile to decisions recorded with none open past the response standard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed trademark licence or marketing agreement filed with execution date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined and conditionally approved requests are logged with the conditions and the reason.
generic.Test population: All co-branding and brand extension decisions made in the period and the assets they permit.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A request fails where the partner lacks required licences or the lockup breaches co-branding rules.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-compliant lockups are returned for rework and cannot proceed to asset production.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval requires an executed agreement with fair-value terms and a mark-withdrawal clause.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository co-branding folder plus the compliance evidence repository decision log.

steps.title: Log the incoming request in the document management repository
sop: Record requesting party, proposed use, channel, duration and territories.
Attach the proposed creative treatment and any partner materials supplied.
Assign the request a reference and a response due date.
Done when the request is logged with a reference and a due date.
verify: Check all required request fields are populated.
Pass when no logged request is missing use, channel, duration or territory.

steps.title: Screen the partner for reputational and regulatory risk
sop: Run the reputational screen on the partner entity and its principals.
Confirm the partner holds the licences required for the product being co-marketed.
Record the screening result and any adverse findings.
Done when the screening outcome is recorded against the request.
verify: Check the licence evidence covers the products and territories requested.
Pass when no unlicensed partner is progressed past screening.

steps.title: Check the proposed lockup against the co-branding rules
sop: Compare the lockup against mark hierarchy, minimum size and prohibited adjacency rules.
Mark each breach specifically rather than rejecting the treatment as a whole.
Return non-compliant treatments to the requester for rework.
Done when the lockup either passes or is returned with the breaches stated.
verify: Re-check any reworked lockup against the same rules.
Pass when no non-compliant lockup proceeds to asset production.

steps.title: Confirm the trademark licence or marketing agreement is in place
sop: Confirm a written agreement covers the mark use, territories and duration requested.
Check the terms are fair value and include termination and mark-withdrawal clauses.
Escalate any agreement missing the withdrawal clause before signature.
Done when an executed agreement covering the request is on file.
verify: Open the executed agreement and locate the withdrawal clause.
Pass when no co-branded asset is permitted without an executed licence.

steps.title: Record the decision with the named approver
sop: Decide approve, approve with conditions, or decline against the screening and lockup results.
State every condition attached to a conditional approval.
Record the approver name, decision date and approval expiry date.
Done when the decision record is complete and dated.
verify: Check the decision record names an approver and an expiry date.
Pass when every logged request carries a recorded decision.

steps.title: File the signed agreement and issue the decision
sop: File the executed agreement and decision record in the document management repository.
Copy the decision record to the compliance evidence repository.
Notify the requester of the decision and any conditions.
Done when the agreement and decision are filed and the requester is notified.
verify: Retrieve the filed agreement from the repository by request reference.
Pass when each approved request has a retrievable executed agreement.

steps.title: Diarise expiry and monitor assets in circulation
sop: Set a reminder ahead of each approval expiry date.
Check circulating co-branded assets against live approvals each period.
Withdraw any asset whose approval or agreement has lapsed.
Done when circulating assets match the live approval list.
verify: Compare the asset circulation list to the approval register.
Pass when no co-branded asset circulates without a live executed licence.

generic.Defined scope/population: All trademarks in active marketing use plus every mark held on the trademark register.
generic.In-scope period: The current review cycle with renewal deadlines diarised at least 90 days ahead.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Register extract carries mark, classes, jurisdiction, status and next renewal date for each entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-use brand asset list reconciles to the filed mark inventory with differences explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Registration certificates and register extracts filed with extract date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Marks used but unfiled, or filed but unused, are logged with a file, abandon or monitor decision.
generic.Test population: Every mark on the register extract and every mark appearing on in-use brand assets.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A gap fails review where a mark in active marketing use has no filing or lapsed protection.
generic.Exception handling path: Unfiled in-use marks are instructed for filing or the use is withdrawn from market.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cycle is accepted when every in-use mark is filed and every renewal deadline is diarised.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository trademark folder holding the register extract and certificates.

steps.title: Reconcile the register extract against the in-use brand asset list
sop: Pull the current trademark register extract into the document management repository.
List the marks appearing on in-use assets from the brand asset inventory.
Match the two lists and flag every unmatched entry in either direction.
Done when every mark on both lists is matched or flagged.
verify: Recount matched and flagged entries against both source lists.
Pass when no mark on either list is left unreconciled.

steps.title: Check filed classes cover the products actually marketed
sop: For each mark list the classes filed and the products and services marketed under it.
Flag any product or service marketed outside the filed classes.
Record the coverage gap and the recommended additional filing.
Done when class coverage is assessed for every mark.
verify: Sample two marks and compare filed classes to marketed products.
Pass when every class coverage gap is recorded with a recommendation.

steps.title: Diarise renewal and declaration-of-use deadlines
sop: Extract every renewal and declaration deadline from the register.
Set a diary reminder at least 90 days ahead of each deadline.
Confirm the outside counsel instruction is issued for the next due items.
Done when every deadline has a reminder and an instruction status.
verify: Check the earliest upcoming deadline has a reminder at least 90 days ahead.
Pass when no deadline is undiarised on the register extract.

steps.title: Instruct filings for marks arising from brand extension approvals
sop: List new marks arising from approved brand extension decisions.
Instruct the filing with the classes and jurisdictions required.
Record the instruction date and the application reference.
Done when each new mark has an instructed filing with a reference.
verify: Match approved brand extensions to instructed filings.
Pass when no approved new mark is left uninstructed.

steps.title: Track application status to registration or refusal
sop: Update the status of each pending application from counsel reporting.
Escalate refusals and office actions with the response deadline.
Record the outcome date against the application reference.
Done when every pending application has a current status.
verify: Check the oldest pending application for a status update this cycle.
Pass when no application is left without a status update in the cycle.

steps.title: File certificates and update the brand asset inventory
sop: File registration certificates and the updated register extract in the repository.
Update the brand asset inventory with the mark status and protection scope.
Copy the register extract to the compliance evidence repository.
Done when the inventory reflects the current register position.
verify: Retrieve one certificate from the repository by mark name.
Pass when no mark in active marketing use is missing from the filing inventory.

steps.title: Report the register position to the chief marketing officer
sop: Present the reconciliation result, coverage gaps and upcoming renewals.
Agree the file, abandon or monitor decision for each flagged mark.
Record the decisions against the register extract.
Done when every flagged mark has an agreed decision.
verify: Check each flagged mark carries a decision and an owner.
Pass when the review record names the approver and the review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The published brand positioning, values and target audience definition under periodic refresh.
generic.In-scope period: A review at least every 12 months, or sooner when tracker evidence triggers a change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The refreshed document carries version, review date, named approver and change note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of proposed changes matches the count of entries in the review log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Superseded version archived and the new version published with an effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Review comments not adopted are logged with the rationale and the decision maker.
generic.Test population: The published positioning document and the downstream assets named in the change note.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Review fails if the document has no review date inside the last 12 months or no named approver.
generic.Exception handling path: Downstream assets not reworked by the change-note deadline are withdrawn from circulation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Refresh is accepted on executive sign-off with the superseded version archived.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository brand positioning folder with current and archived versions.

steps.title: Compare current positioning against the latest tracker evidence
sop: Pull the latest brand tracker results from the BI/reporting platform.
Compare positioning, values and audience definition against the tracker findings.
Add the competitor positioning review to the comparison.
Done when every current statement has a supporting or contradicting evidence note.
verify: Check the evidence note cites the tracker wave and date.
Pass when no current statement is left without an evidence assessment.

steps.title: List the statements proposed for change
sop: List each statement proposed for change with its current and proposed wording.
Note the specific evidence that triggers each change.
Mark statements confirmed as unchanged so the review is complete.
Done when the change list covers every proposed amendment.
verify: Check each proposed change cites a triggering evidence item.
Pass when no proposed change lacks a stated evidence trigger.

steps.title: Circulate the redline and capture responses
sop: Send the redline to product, distribution and compliance with a response deadline.
Record every response in the review log with a disposition.
Note the rationale for each comment not adopted.
Done when every response has a recorded disposition.
verify: Reconcile responses received against dispositions logged.
Pass when no response is left undispositioned in the review log.

steps.title: Obtain executive sign-off on the refreshed positioning
sop: Present the change list, the evidence and the review log.
Confirm or amend each proposed change.
Record the approval with approver name and date.
Done when the refreshed positioning is signed off.
verify: Check the approval record names the approver and the date.
Pass when the document shows a review date within the last 12 months.

steps.title: Publish the new version and archive the superseded one
sop: Apply the new version number and effective date.
Publish to the document management repository brand folder.
Archive the superseded version so it cannot be downloaded as current.
Done when only the new version is marked current.
verify: Search the folder for prior versions still marked current.
Pass when no superseded positioning version remains downloadable.

steps.title: Issue the change note listing downstream rework
sop: List the downstream assets carrying the superseded positioning.
State the rework deadline and the owner for each asset group.
Circulate the change note through Microsoft 365 / SharePoint and the marketing channel.
Done when every affected asset group has an owner and a deadline.
verify: Check the change note against the affected asset inventory.
Pass when no affected asset group is missing from the change note.

steps.title: Track downstream rework to the change-note deadline
sop: Track each asset group against its rework deadline.
Chase overdue owners and record the escalation.
Withdraw assets still carrying superseded positioning past the deadline.
Done when every asset group is reworked or withdrawn.
verify: Sample live assets for superseded positioning wording.
Pass when no downstream asset carries superseded positioning past the deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: The quarterly brand health metric set reported to marketing leadership from the tracker dataset.
generic.In-scope period: The reported quarter with prior-quarter and year-ago comparisons.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric shows current value, prior quarter, year ago, source dataset and refresh timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dashboard figures reconcile to the source tracker tables before circulation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard export and reconciliation filed with the refresh timestamp and dataset version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics failing reconciliation are held from the pack until corrected and re-reconciled.
generic.Test population: Every metric presented in the quarterly brand health pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A metric fails where it has no governed source dataset or does not reconcile to the tracker tables.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled metrics are removed from the pack and raised to the insights lead for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack is accepted when reconciliation is recorded and every significant move carries commentary.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint brand reporting folder holding the pack and the reconciliation record.

steps.title: Refresh the brand health dashboard in Power BI
sop: Refresh the dashboard from the governed tracker dataset.
Confirm the wave and weighting match the published methodology.
Record the refresh timestamp and dataset version on the dashboard.
Done when the dashboard shows the current quarter with its refresh timestamp.
verify: Check the displayed wave identifier against the published methodology.
Pass when the dashboard shows the source dataset and refresh timestamp.

steps.title: Assemble the quarterly metric view
sop: Compile unaided and aided awareness, favourability, consideration, net sentiment and share of voice.
Add the prior-quarter and year-ago comparison for each metric.
Lay the metrics out in the standard leadership pack format.
Done when every required metric appears with both comparisons.
verify: Count metrics presented against the required metric list.
Pass when no required metric is missing a prior-quarter or year-ago value.

steps.title: Write commentary on significant movements
sop: Identify every metric moving more than the stated significance threshold.
Write commentary tying each move to campaign activity or market events.
State where a cause cannot be determined rather than inferring one.
Done when every significant move has written commentary.
verify: Cross-check flagged moves against commentary entries.
Pass when no significant move is left without commentary.

steps.title: Reconcile dashboard figures to the source tracker tables
sop: Compare each dashboard figure against the underlying tracker table value.
Investigate and resolve every difference before circulation.
Record the reconciliation with the date and the person performing it.
Done when the reconciliation record shows no unexplained difference.
verify: Re-check two reconciled figures against the tracker tables.
Pass when no metric is circulated without passing reconciliation.

steps.title: Circulate the pack to marketing leadership
sop: Issue the pack to the leadership distribution list ahead of the meeting.
Attach the reconciliation record and the methodology note.
File the pack in the Microsoft 365 / SharePoint reporting folder.
Done when the pack is issued and filed.
verify: Confirm the filed pack includes the reconciliation record.
Pass when the issued pack matches the filed version.

steps.title: Present the pack and log agreed actions
sop: Walk leadership through the metric movements and the commentary.
Agree the actions arising with named owners and dates.
Record the actions in the meeting record.
Done when every agreed action has an owner and a date.
verify: Check the meeting record lists owners against all actions.
Pass when no agreed action is recorded without an owner.

steps.title: Confirm every reported metric has a governed source
sop: List each reported metric with its source dataset reference.
Remove or requalify any metric sourced outside the governed datasets.
Record the source list alongside the pack.
Done when every metric has a recorded governed source.
verify: Trace two metrics back to their governed dataset.
Pass when no reported metric lacks a governed source dataset.

generic.Defined scope/population: Brand health tracker results and social listening feeds loaded into the brand health dataset.
generic.In-scope period: The current tracker wave and listening period, held against the prior wave for trend.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every loaded row carries a segment code, weight, wave identifier and load timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Row counts per segment match expectations and weights sum to the sample frame.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Load logs and data quality results retained with the wave identifier and load timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows failing data quality rules are quarantined with the rule breached and the fix applied.
generic.Test population: All rows loaded to the brand health dataset for the current wave.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The load fails on null segment codes, unexpected row counts or weights not summing to the frame.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed rows are held out of the reporting layer until corrected and reloaded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The wave is accepted when data quality passes and comparability breaks are noted in the dataset.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse brand health load logs and the BI/reporting platform dataset.

steps.title: Load tracker results and listening feed into the warehouse
sop: Load the current wave tracker results into the brand health dataset.
Load the social listening feed for the matching period.
Stamp every row with the wave identifier and load timestamp.
Done when both sources are loaded with wave identifiers applied.
verify: Check the loaded wave identifier against the fielding record.
Pass when every loaded row carries a wave identifier and load timestamp.

steps.title: Run the data quality rules on the load
sop: Check expected row count per segment against the fielded completes.
Check for null segment codes and reject rows that carry them.
Check the weights sum to the sample frame.
Done when the data quality run has produced a result for every rule.
verify: Review the data quality output for each rule.
Pass when no rule failure is left unresolved before publication.

steps.title: Quarantine failing rows and resolve them
sop: Move rows failing any rule into the quarantine table.
Record the rule breached and the correction applied.
Reload corrected rows and re-run the rules.
Done when quarantine is empty or every remaining row has a documented disposition.
verify: Check the quarantine table against the exception log.
Pass when no failing row is published to the reporting layer.

steps.title: Recalculate the trend series
sop: Recalculate awareness, favourability, perception attributes and sentiment for the wave.
Compare each series against the prior wave value.
Record the movement and the significance result.
Done when all tracked series are recalculated with prior-wave comparison.
verify: Recompute one series independently as a check.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the published series.

steps.title: Flag threshold breaches to the marketing manager
sop: Identify metrics breaching their alert threshold.
Attach the underlying cut showing which segment drives the movement.
Raise the flagged metrics to the marketing manager.
Done when every breach is raised with its underlying cut.
verify: Compare flagged metrics against the threshold definitions.
Pass when no threshold breach is left unraised.

steps.title: Publish the refreshed series to the BI/reporting platform
sop: Publish the refreshed series to the reporting layer.
Confirm the dashboards pick up the new wave.
Record the publication timestamp.
Done when the reporting layer shows the current wave.
verify: Open the published dashboard and check the wave shown.
Pass when the published wave matches the loaded wave identifier.

steps.title: Note methodology changes that break comparability
sop: Record any questionnaire or methodology change affecting the wave.
Annotate the affected series in the dataset so trend readers see the break.
Include the note in the wave documentation.
Done when every comparability break is annotated.
verify: Open an affected series and check the annotation shows.
Pass when no comparability break is published without an annotation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All DAM assets past their expiry date or superseded by a newer approved version.
generic.In-scope period: The current retirement run covering assets expiring or superseded in the period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each retirement row carries asset ID, expiry reason, withdrawal date and archive location.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expired-asset report count reconciles to the count of assets moved to archive state.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive record holds the retired version with withdrawal timestamp and retention expiry date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assets that cannot be withdrawn on time are logged with the blocker and a revised withdrawal date.
generic.Test population: Every asset on the expired-asset report for the period plus the live surfaces they appeared on.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A retirement fails if the asset remains downloadable or is still live on any customer-facing surface.
generic.Exception handling path: Assets still live are escalated to the surface owner for immediate removal and re-checked.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run is accepted when no expired asset is active and every retirement is logged with a retention date.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository content retirement log plus the archive store in the repository.

steps.title: Run the expired-asset report in the document management repository
sop: Filter the DAM for assets past their expiry date or superseded by a newer version.
Export the report with asset ID, owner, expiry date and supersession reference.
Record the report count as the retirement control total.
Done when the expired-asset report is produced with a control total.
verify: Re-run the filter and compare counts.
Pass when the report count is recorded as the control total for the run.

steps.title: Check each expired asset against the live surfaces
sop: Check the website, landing pages, broker portal, email templates and social scheduler for each asset.
Check the printed stock list for physical items still in circulation.
Record where the asset is still present and who owns that surface.
Done when every expired asset has a checked surface list.
verify: Spot-check two assets against the live website and portal.
Pass when every expired asset has a recorded surface check result.

steps.title: Remove the asset from every live surface
sop: Request removal from each surface owner where the asset is still present.
Confirm removal by re-checking the surface after the change.
Escalate any surface not cleared within the agreed window.
Done when no expired asset remains on a live surface.
verify: Re-check the surfaces recorded as clearing this run.
Pass when no expired asset is reachable on a customer-facing surface.

steps.title: Move the asset to archive state in the repository
sop: Set the asset state to archived so it is no longer downloadable by marketing or field users.
Confirm it remains retrievable for regulatory production.
Record the archive location against the asset ID.
Done when every expired asset is in archive state with a location recorded.
verify: Attempt a download as a standard marketing user.
Pass when no archived asset is downloadable while remaining retrievable on request.

steps.title: Apply the retention clock per the advertising records schedule
sop: Apply the advertising records retention period to each archived asset.
Record the destruction-eligible date rather than deleting the asset.
Confirm no archived asset is deleted before that date.
Done when every archived asset carries a destruction-eligible date.
verify: Sample archived records for retention dates.
Pass when no archived asset lacks a destruction-eligible date.

steps.title: Log the retirement in the content register
sop: Record asset ID, expiry reason, withdrawal date and archive location in the content register.
Reconcile the register entries to the expired-asset report count.
File the register extract in the compliance evidence repository.
Done when every retired asset has a register entry.
verify: Compare register entries to the control total.
Pass when the register entry count matches the expired-asset report count.

steps.title: Review the retirement run with compliance
sop: Review exceptions where removal was late or blocked.
Agree the corrective action and revised withdrawal date for each.
Sign the run as complete in the register.
Done when every exception has an agreed action and the run is signed.
verify: Check each exception carries an owner and revised date.
Pass when no expired asset remains in an active downloadable state.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active marketing assets in the DAM that require a governed expiry date.
generic.In-scope period: The current governance cycle covering the rolling 30, 60 and 90-day expiry horizon.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every active asset record carries a non-null expiry date, an owner and a renewal decision field.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assets on the expiry report reconcile to the assets routed to owners for action.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal approvals recorded against the asset with re-approver name, date and evidence reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assets whose expiry passes without action are logged and forced to retire or renew.
generic.Test population: All active asset records and the 30, 60 and 90-day expiry report for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An asset fails governance if its expiry date is null or already in the past while still active.
generic.Exception handling path: Uploads without an expiry date are rejected and returned to the uploader before storage.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cycle is accepted when the expiry report has an assigned owner against every listed item.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository asset records plus the compliance evidence repository expiry log.

steps.title: Enforce a mandatory expiry date at upload
sop: Check every asset created this period for a populated expiry date at upload.
Reject and return any upload with a blank expiry field.
Record the rejection so repeat offenders can be coached.
Done when no asset created this period has a blank expiry date.
verify: Query the repository for active assets with a null expiry date.
Pass when the null expiry query returns no active asset.

steps.title: Set the expiry date from the shortest-lived dependency
sop: List the dependencies on the asset: rate or product term, statistic vintage, disclosure version, campaign end.
Set the expiry to the earliest of those dependency dates.
Record which dependency drove the date on the asset record.
Done when every asset expiry is traceable to a named dependency.
verify: Sample three assets and check the expiry against the named dependency.
Pass when no expiry date is later than its shortest-lived dependency.

steps.title: Run the 30/60/90-day expiry report
sop: Run the expiry horizon report from the document management repository.
Group the items by owner and by required action.
Record the report run date and the item count.
Done when the expiry report for the period is produced.
verify: Check the report covers all three horizons.
Pass when the report count is recorded for the period.

steps.title: Route each item to its owner for renew, revise or retire
sop: Send each listed item to its named owner with the required action and deadline.
Track responses and chase items with no decision.
Escalate items with no owner response before expiry.
Done when every listed item has an assigned owner and a decision path.
verify: Compare routed items to the report item count.
Pass when every item on the expiry report has an assigned owner.

steps.title: Re-substantiate claims on assets being renewed
sop: Check every claim and statistic on the renewing asset against a current source.
Record the refreshed evidence reference against the asset.
Reject renewal where a claim can no longer be substantiated.
Done when each renewing asset carries current evidence references.
verify: Open two refreshed evidence references and check their dates.
Pass when no renewed asset carries a claim without current evidence.

steps.title: Update the expiry date and record the re-approver
sop: Set the new expiry date on renewal from the refreshed dependencies.
Record who re-approved the asset and the approval date.
Copy the approval reference to the compliance evidence repository.
Done when every renewed asset shows a new expiry and a named re-approver.
verify: Check renewed assets for a re-approver name and date.
Pass when no renewed asset carries a past expiry date.

steps.title: Force retirement for items that pass expiry without action
sop: List assets that reached expiry with no renewal decision.
Set them to retired so they cannot be used.
Log the forced retirement with the owner who failed to act.
Done when no expired asset remains active.
verify: Query active assets with a past expiry date.
Pass when the query returns no active asset with a past expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every localized variant produced from an approved master asset for a target market or channel.
generic.In-scope period: The current localization run tied to the master asset's approval validity window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each variant carries master asset ID, market, language, channel and approval reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Variant count uploaded reconciles to the variant list agreed at the start of the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each variant stored as a child of the master with its own approval date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variants failing local compliance review are logged and held from release until reworked.
generic.Test population: All localized variants produced in the run and their target-market disclosure sets.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A variant fails if it carries a disclosure, licence number or figure from another jurisdiction.
generic.Exception handling path: Variants with carried-over master figures are returned to production for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release requires a target-market compliance review, not reliance on the master approval.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository variant records linked to the master asset ID.

steps.title: Record the variant list against the approved master asset
sop: Take the approved master asset and confirm its approval is current.
List each variant to be produced with target market, language and channel.
Record the variant list against the master asset ID.
Done when the variant list is recorded and the master approval confirmed.
verify: Check the master approval date and expiry.
Pass when no variant is started from an expired master approval.

steps.title: Swap product names, figures and legal entity for the target market
sop: Replace product name, rate and benefit figures with the values valid in the target market.
Replace the legal entity with the entity licensed in that market.
Never carry a master figure across without checking local validity.
Done when every market-specific value is replaced in each variant.
verify: Compare two variants against the target-market product sheet.
Pass when no variant carries a figure or entity from the master market.

steps.title: Apply jurisdiction-specific mandatory disclosures
sop: Apply the mandatory disclosures for the target state or country to each variant.
Insert the correct licence numbers and complaint-handling wording.
Remove any disclosure that belongs to another jurisdiction.
Done when each variant carries its own jurisdiction disclosure set.
verify: Check each variant against the target-market disclosure library.
Pass when no variant shows a disclosure or licence number from another jurisdiction.

steps.title: Route translation and adapted claims for local compliance review
sop: Submit the translated copy and adapted claims for target-market review.
Do not rely on the master approval to cover the localized wording.
Record the reviewer, decision and date per variant.
Done when every variant has a target-market review decision.
verify: Check the review record covers the localized wording, not just the master.
Pass when no variant is released without its own market review decision.

steps.title: Rework variants that fail local review
sop: Apply every mandatory change raised by the local reviewer.
Log any change rejected with the rationale and re-route it.
Resubmit the reworked variant for a second decision.
Done when no variant is left with an open local review comment.
verify: Check the review log for open comments on released variants.
Pass when no released variant has an unresolved compliance comment.

steps.title: Upload variants as children of the master asset
sop: Upload each variant linked to the master asset ID in the document management repository.
Populate market, language, channel and approval reference in the metadata.
Set the expiry date from the shortest-lived local dependency.
Done when every variant is stored as a linked child with full metadata.
verify: Open the master record and list its child variants.
Pass when each variant is linked to its master with market and language recorded.

steps.title: Publish variants to the marketing automation platform for their channels
sop: Load each approved variant into the channel it was localized for.
Confirm the channel targeting matches the variant market.
Record the publication against the variant record.
Done when every variant is live only in its intended market.
verify: Check channel targeting against the variant market metadata.
Pass when no variant is deployed to a market other than the one it was approved for.

generic.Defined scope/population: All planned content items for the coming quarter across owned marketing channels.
generic.In-scope period: The coming quarter, with the current month locked against unapproved additions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each calendar item carries theme, funnel stage, segment, channel, owner and publish date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Slotted item volume reconciles to the confirmed internal and agency production capacity.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published calendar version stored with publication date and the locked-month marker.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items cut or moved for capacity reasons are logged with the reason and a revised date.
generic.Test population: Every item on the published quarterly editorial calendar.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An item fails if it has no owner, no publish date or no compliance review window before publish.
generic.Exception handling path: Late additions to a locked month require the marketing manager's documented approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calendar is accepted when capacity is confirmed and every item has an owner and review window.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint editorial calendar folder holding the published quarter version.

steps.title: Load the fixed anchors onto the editorial grid
sop: Import the campaign calendar, product launch dates and event dates into the grid.
Mark each as a fixed anchor that content must work around.
Confirm the anchor dates with the campaign and event owners.
Done when every fixed anchor is on the grid and confirmed.
verify: Compare the grid anchors against the campaign and event calendars.
Pass when no confirmed launch or event date is missing from the grid.

steps.title: Slot content items against each anchor
sop: Slot items by theme, funnel stage, target segment and channel.
Mark the primary asset and its derivatives for each item.
Assign an owner to each slotted item.
Done when every anchor has its supporting content slotted with owners.
verify: Check each item carries theme, funnel stage, segment and channel.
Pass when no slotted item is missing an owner.

steps.title: Set working-back dates for each item
sop: Set the brief, first draft, compliance review window, final approval and publish dates.
Work back from the publish date using the standard lead times.
Flag items whose lead time is already impossible.
Done when every item has a full set of working-back dates.
verify: Check the compliance review window sits before the publish date on each item.
Pass when no item is scheduled without a compliance review window.

steps.title: Confirm production capacity against slotted volume
sop: Total the internal copy and design hours and the agency slots available.
Compare the total against the hours implied by the slotted volume.
Identify the overflow by week and by discipline.
Done when capacity and demand are compared for the quarter.
verify: Recheck the capacity total against the confirmed resourcing.
Pass when the demand total is within the confirmed capacity.

steps.title: Cut or move items that exceed capacity
sop: Decide which overflow items are cut, moved or resourced externally.
Log each decision with the reason and the revised date.
Rebalance the grid after the decisions are applied.
Done when the slotted volume fits the confirmed capacity.
verify: Recompute the demand total after the cuts.
Pass when no week remains over its confirmed capacity.

steps.title: Publish the calendar to the marketing channel
sop: Publish the quarter calendar to Microsoft 365 / SharePoint with a version number.
Post the link and the change summary to the marketing channel.
Record the publication date.
Done when the calendar is published and announced.
verify: Open the published version and check the item count.
Pass when the published calendar shows an owner and publish date on every item.

steps.title: Lock the current month against unapproved additions
sop: Set the current month to locked on the published calendar.
Require the marketing manager's approval for any late addition.
Log each approved late addition with the reason.
Done when the current month is locked and the approval route is stated.
verify: Check late additions in the locked month for a recorded approval.
Pass when no item was added to the locked month without approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Creative content assets produced against a signed-off brief in the current production run.
generic.In-scope period: The production window between brief sign-off and submission to compliance review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each asset carries headline, body copy, visual, call to action and the required legal footer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of claims in copy reconciles to the count of entries on the claim source list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft submitted with the approved brief and claim source list attached and dated.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims without a usable source are logged and removed or reworded before submission.
generic.Test population: All draft assets submitted for compliance review in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A draft fails if any statistic, rating or comparative claim in copy has no source reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsourced claims are returned to the author and the asset is held from review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission is accepted when the brief, sources and jurisdiction disclosures are all attached.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository draft asset record holding the brief and claim source list.

steps.title: Produce the asset against the signed-off brief
sop: Build headline, body copy, visual and call to action to the brief.
Include the required legal footer for the intended use.
Check the asset answers the brief's stated objective.
Done when a complete draft exists against the signed-off brief.
verify: Compare the draft against each brief requirement.
Pass when no brief requirement is unmet in the draft.

steps.title: Apply the brand guideline rules to the draft
sop: Apply the approved logo lockup, colour values, typeface and image style.
Apply the tone of voice defined for the stated audience.
Correct any element that departs from the guideline.
Done when the draft conforms to the current brand guidelines.
verify: Check the lockup, colours and typeface against the guideline document.
Pass when no guideline element is breached in the draft.

steps.title: Attach a source reference to every claim in copy
sop: List every statistic, rating, award and comparative claim used.
Attach the source reference and its date to each entry.
Remove or reword claims with no usable source.
Done when the claim source list covers every claim in the copy.
verify: Count claims in the copy against entries on the source list.
Pass when no claim in the copy is missing from the source list.

steps.title: Insert mandatory disclosure and licence wording
sop: Insert the product disclosure, licence and legal entity wording for each intended jurisdiction.
Check the wording matches the current approved disclosure library.
Confirm the disclosures are legible in the intended output format.
Done when every intended jurisdiction has its disclosure block in place.
verify: Compare the inserted wording against the disclosure library.
Pass when no intended jurisdiction is missing its mandatory wording.

steps.title: Run copy-edit and proof on the draft
sop: Check product names and figures against the current product sheet.
Remove superlatives and any wording implying a guarantee.
Click every link and confirm it resolves to the intended destination.
Done when the proof pass is complete with corrections applied.
verify: Re-read the corrected copy against the product sheet.
Pass when no product name or figure in copy differs from the product sheet.

steps.title: Review the draft with the marketing manager
sop: Review the draft against the brief objective and the campaign message map.
Request changes where the asset misses the audience or the proposition.
Approve the draft for submission to compliance.
Done when the manager has approved the draft for submission.
verify: Check the manager approval is recorded on the asset record.
Pass when no asset is submitted without the manager approval recorded.

steps.title: Submit the draft to compliance review with its evidence pack
sop: Attach the approved brief and the claim source list to the submission.
State the intended channels, jurisdictions and audience.
Record the submission date on the asset record.
Done when the draft is submitted with its full evidence pack.
verify: Open the submission and confirm both attachments are present.
Pass when no draft reaches compliance without brief and sources attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assets that have completed review and are being finalised into approved output versions.
generic.In-scope period: The finalisation window between review completion and release to channel owners.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Final asset record carries version number, compliance approval reference and approval date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of review comments reconciles to the count of comments marked applied, rejected or deferred.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Locked final files stored with version number and approval date in the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected review comments are logged with the rationale and the person who rejected them.
generic.Test population: Every asset marked final in the run and its full review comment log.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An asset fails if any compliance comment is open or any mandatory change was paraphrased.
generic.Exception handling path: Assets with open compliance comments are returned to rework and cannot be marked final.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Final status requires a locked file with an attached compliance approval reference and date.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository final asset record plus the compliance evidence repository approval.

steps.title: Work through the review log comment by comment
sop: Mark each comment applied, rejected with rationale, or deferred with a date.
Leave no comment unactioned in the log.
Summarise the disposition counts at the foot of the log.
Done when every review comment carries a disposition.
verify: Count comments received against comments dispositioned.
Pass when no review comment is left unactioned.

steps.title: Confirm mandatory compliance changes were applied verbatim
sop: List the changes compliance marked as mandatory.
Compare the applied wording against the wording required.
Reject any paraphrased mandatory wording and return it for correction.
Done when every mandatory change matches the required wording exactly.
verify: Diff the applied wording against the compliance instruction.
Pass when no mandatory change was paraphrased in the final asset.

steps.title: Produce the final files in the required output formats
sop: Export the asset in each format and dimension required by its channels.
Re-proof the legal footer on every output rather than only on the master.
Check image quality and text legibility at the delivered sizes.
Done when every required output format exists and is proofed.
verify: Open each output and check the legal footer renders.
Pass when no output format is missing or shows a truncated legal footer.

steps.title: Increment the version and lock the file
sop: Increment the version number against the predecessor record.
Lock the file so it cannot be edited in place.
Confirm the version history links back to the prior version.
Done when the final version is locked with a linked version history.
verify: Attempt an edit on the locked file.
Pass when the final version is locked and linked to its predecessor.

steps.title: Attach the compliance approval reference and date
sop: Attach the compliance approval reference to the asset record.
Record the approval date and the approval expiry date.
Copy the approval to the compliance evidence repository.
Done when the asset record shows the approval reference and both dates.
verify: Open the asset record and check the approval fields.
Pass when no asset is marked final without an attached approval reference.

steps.title: Notify channel owners that the final version supersedes drafts
sop: Notify each channel owner that the final approved version is available.
State that any earlier draft in circulation is superseded.
Record the notification against the asset record.
Done when every channel owner has been notified.
verify: Check the notification list against the asset's channel list.
Pass when no channel owner is missing from the notification record.

steps.title: Confirm no draft version remains in circulation
sop: Search the repository and shared folders for superseded drafts.
Archive or remove any draft still reachable by users.
Log the removals against the asset record.
Done when only the final version is reachable.
verify: Search for the asset by name and list reachable versions.
Pass when only the locked final version is available to users.

generic.Defined scope/population: All marketing assets submitted for compliance and brand review in the review period.
generic.In-scope period: The review period, with each approval valid only to its recorded expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each submission carries brief, claim source list, channels, jurisdictions and audience.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submissions received reconcile to review outcomes recorded with none left open past the standard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review record stored with reviewer name, decision, date and approval expiry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected and approved-with-changes assets are logged with the specific required changes.
generic.Test population: Every asset routed through compliance and brand review in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An asset fails on prohibited language, missing disclosures or a mismatch to the filed product.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected assets return to production and cannot publish until a new decision is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication requires a completed review record with reviewer, decision, date and expiry.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository review log linked to the document repository asset record.

steps.title: Accept the submission with its full context pack
sop: Check the submission includes the brief, claim source list, channels, jurisdictions and audience.
Return incomplete submissions to the author rather than reviewing them partially.
Log the submission with its received date.
Done when the submission is logged as complete.
verify: Check each logged submission for all five context items.
Pass when no incomplete submission enters the review queue.

steps.title: Check the copy for prohibited language
sop: Check for guarantees of outcome and unqualified superlatives.
Check for unsupported comparisons and implied endorsement.
Mark each breach against the specific line of copy.
Done when the prohibited language check is recorded for the asset.
verify: Re-read the marked lines against the prohibited language list.
Pass when no prohibited phrase remains in an approved asset.

steps.title: Verify disclosures against the filed product and jurisdictions
sop: Check mandatory disclosures, licence numbers and legal entity against the filed product.
Check each listed jurisdiction has its required wording present.
Reject where the product name differs from the filed name.
Done when disclosures are verified for every listed jurisdiction.
verify: Compare the asset against the filed product record.
Pass when no approved asset differs from the filed product name or disclosures.

steps.title: Route to additional reviewers where required
sop: Route product-specific pieces to the product reviewer and legal where required.
Route pieces needing pre-use filing to the regulator-filing queue.
Track each additional review to a recorded decision.
Done when every required additional review has a decision.
verify: Check the routing matrix against the asset's product and jurisdictions.
Pass when no asset is approved with a required additional review outstanding.

steps.title: Record the review outcome in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Record approved, approved-with-changes or rejected against the asset.
Record the reviewer name, decision date and approval expiry.
State the specific required changes where changes are needed.
Done when the outcome record is complete for the asset.
verify: Open the review record and check all four fields.
Pass when no reviewed asset lacks reviewer, decision, date and expiry.

steps.title: Return changes to the author and track rework
sop: Send the required changes to the asset author with a deadline.
Track the rework and resubmission against the original review record.
Escalate assets not reworked before the campaign need-by date.
Done when every changed asset is resubmitted or withdrawn.
verify: Compare rework items against resubmissions received.
Pass when no required change is left unreworked past its deadline.

steps.title: Report the review queue position to the marketing manager
sop: Report submissions received, decisions issued and items past the service standard.
Agree the priority for any item blocking a campaign launch.
Record the agreed priorities in the review log.
Done when the queue position is reported and priorities agreed.
verify: Check the queue report against the review log entries.
Pass when no asset is published externally without a completed review record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All compliance-approved assets being catalogued into the digital asset management library.
generic.In-scope period: The current storage run covering assets approved and released in the period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Asset type, campaign, product line, segment, channel, jurisdiction, owner, approval reference and expiry are set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assets approved in the period reconcile to assets stored with an approval reference.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each asset stored with its version number, approval reference and expiry date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Uploads rejected for missing approval or metadata are logged with the reason and outcome.
generic.Test population: Every asset record created or versioned in the storage run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An upload fails where any mandatory metadata field is blank or the approval reference is absent.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected uploads are returned to the uploader and re-checked before storage.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Storage is accepted when metadata is complete, versioning is linked and permissions are set.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository and OpenText Document Mgmt asset records for the period.

steps.title: Reject uploads without a compliance approval reference
sop: Check each upload carries a compliance approval reference.
Reject and return uploads with no reference.
Log the rejection with the uploader and the reason.
Done when every stored upload carries an approval reference.
verify: Query stored assets for a blank approval reference.
Pass when the query returns no stored asset without an approval reference.

steps.title: Complete the mandatory metadata at upload
sop: Populate asset type, campaign, product line, target segment and channel.
Populate jurisdiction, owner, approval reference and expiry date.
Block the upload from completing while any field is blank.
Done when every mandatory field is populated on the asset record.
verify: Run the incomplete-metadata report for the run.
Pass when no stored asset has an incomplete mandatory metadata field.

steps.title: Apply taxonomy tags and the file naming convention
sop: Apply the taxonomy tags for campaign, product and channel.
Rename the file to the naming convention.
Test a search by campaign, product and channel to confirm findability.
Done when the asset is retrievable by all three search routes.
verify: Search the library by campaign and by product for the asset.
Pass when the asset returns on both searches.

steps.title: Version the asset against its predecessor
sop: Attach the upload as a new version of the existing record where one exists.
Do not create a new record for a revision of an existing asset.
Confirm the version history and prior approvals remain linked.
Done when the asset shows a linked version history.
verify: Open the version history and check the prior approvals are visible.
Pass when no revision is stored as a detached new record.

steps.title: Set access permissions by audience
sop: Set permissions for internal, producer-facing and public audiences.
Confirm the producer-facing set is visible in the broker portal.
Confirm internal-only assets are not exposed externally.
Done when permissions match the intended audience for each asset.
verify: Check a producer-facing asset from a producer view.
Pass when no internal-only asset is reachable from an external view.

steps.title: Reconcile approvals issued to assets stored
sop: List approvals issued in the period from the compliance evidence repository.
Match them to assets stored in the library.
Chase any approved asset not yet stored.
Done when every approval issued has a matching stored asset or a logged reason.
verify: Compare the approval list count to the stored asset count.
Pass when every approved asset is stored or its absence is explained.

steps.title: Confirm the stored set with the marketing manager
sop: Review the run summary of assets stored, rejected and outstanding.
Agree remediation for any rejected upload.
Sign the storage run as complete.
Done when the run is signed off with exceptions assigned.
verify: Check each rejected upload has an owner and a remediation date.
Pass when each approved asset is stored with approval reference, version and expiry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Content briefs for the priority assets on the current editorial and campaign calendar.
generic.In-scope period: The planning window ahead of each asset's production commissioning date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each brief states objective, audience, channel, format, mandatory elements and success measure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of signed-off briefs matches the count of priority assets due for production.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed-off brief attached to the asset record with sign-off name and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assets commissioned without a brief are logged and halted until a brief is signed off.
generic.Test population: All priority assets scheduled for production in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A brief fails if it lacks a measurable outcome, a defined audience or named claim evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Claims with no available evidence are removed from the brief before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Brief is accepted on marketing manager sign-off and attachment to the asset record.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint brief folder linked from the document repository asset record.

steps.title: Open the brief against the calendar item
