sop: Create the brief from the standard template against the calendar item.
State the business objective the asset serves.
State the single measurable outcome the asset must drive.
Done when the brief states one objective and one measurable outcome.
verify: Check the outcome is measurable rather than descriptive.
Pass when the brief states a single measurable success outcome.

steps.title: Define the audience precisely from insight
sop: State the segment, funnel stage and product held or targeted.
State the insight or evidence that justifies the creative angle.
Attach the supporting data from the BI/reporting platform.
Done when the audience and its justifying insight are stated.
verify: Open the attached insight and check it supports the angle.
Pass when the brief names a segment and a supporting insight source.

steps.title: Specify channel, format and mandatory elements
sop: State the channel, format, dimensions and word count.
List the mandatory elements including required disclosures.
State the call to action and where it must appear.
Done when the production specification is complete.
verify: Compare the specification against the channel requirements.
Pass when no mandatory element for the channel is missing from the brief.

steps.title: List the claims and name the evidence for each
sop: List every claim the asset is expected to make.
Name the evidence source for each claim.
Remove claims with no available evidence before sign-off.
Done when every listed claim carries a named evidence source.
verify: Open two evidence sources named in the brief.
Pass when no claim in the brief lacks a named evidence source.

steps.title: Obtain marketing manager sign-off on the brief
sop: Review the brief against the campaign objective and calendar slot.
Request changes where the audience or outcome is unclear.
Record the sign-off name and date on the brief.
Done when the brief carries a recorded sign-off.
verify: Check the brief for a sign-off name and date.
Pass when no brief is issued to production without a recorded sign-off.

steps.title: Attach the brief to the asset record
sop: Attach the signed-off brief to the asset record in the document management repository.
Link the brief from the calendar item so production can find it.
Record the attachment date.
Done when the brief is attached and linked from the calendar.
verify: Open the asset record and confirm the brief opens.
Pass when no asset is in production without an attached approved brief.

steps.title: Confirm brief coverage across the priority asset list
sop: Reconcile signed-off briefs to the priority asset list for the period.
Halt commissioning for any asset without a brief.
Log the exceptions with owners and target dates.
Done when every priority asset has a brief or a logged exception.
verify: Compare the brief count to the priority asset count.
Pass when every priority asset has a signed-off brief on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The campaign segment lists submitted for suppression before release to the campaign platform.
generic.In-scope period: The suppression run immediately before audience release, using same-day suppression sources.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every contact row carries contact ID, channel identifiers and the suppression flags applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pre-suppression count minus removals by rule equals the final mailable count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Suppression run log retained with run timestamp, source refresh dates and counts per rule.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows removed by each rule are logged with the rule name and retained for audit.
generic.Test population: The final campaign audience released to the marketing automation platform.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The run fails if any contact with a channel opt-out or STOP flag survives into the final audience.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed spot-check halts audience release until suppression is re-run against refreshed sources.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release is accepted when counts reconcile and the compliance spot-check passes.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse suppression run log and the campaign record in the automation platform.

steps.title: Refresh the suppression sources in the warehouse
sop: Refresh global marketing opt-out, per-channel unsubscribes and the SMS STOP list.
Refresh internal do-not-contact, national do-not-call and deceased or bad-address flags.
Record the refresh timestamp for each source.
Done when every suppression source shows a current refresh timestamp.
verify: Check each source refresh timestamp against the run date.
Pass when no suppression source is older than the agreed refresh window.

steps.title: Apply the contact-fatigue recency rule
sop: Pull the contact history for the defined recency window from the CRM.
Exclude contacts already messaged inside that window.
Record the count excluded by the fatigue rule.
Done when the fatigue exclusion is applied and counted.
verify: Sample excluded contacts against their contact history.
Pass when no contact inside the recency window survives into the audience.

steps.title: Exclude contacts in dispute or complaint states
sop: Identify contacts in an open complaint, litigation or claim-dispute state in the CRM.
Exclude them from promotional targeting for this campaign.
Record the count excluded and the source of the flag.
Done when all disputed-state contacts are excluded.
verify: Sample the excluded set against the CRM case records.
Pass when no contact with an open complaint or dispute remains in the audience.

steps.title: Run the suppression job and record the counts
sop: Run the suppression job across all attached rules.
Record the pre-suppression count and the count removed per rule.
Record the final mailable count.
Done when the run log shows counts for every rule and the final total.
verify: Recompute pre-suppression minus removals against the final count.
Pass when the arithmetic reconciles exactly.

steps.title: Spot-check the suppressed list against the opt-out source
sop: Draw a sample from the final audience and check it against the opt-out sources.
Draw a sample from the removed set and confirm the rule applied is correct.
Record the spot-check result and the sample size.
Done when the spot-check result is recorded.
verify: Review the spot-check findings.
Pass when no opt-out or STOP contact appears in the final audience sample.

steps.title: Release the audience to the marketing automation platform
sop: Release the final audience only after the spot-check has passed.
Load through the approved route and confirm the loaded count.
Record the release timestamp on the campaign record.
Done when the released audience count matches the final mailable count.
verify: Compare the loaded count to the final mailable count.
Pass when the platform audience count equals the post-suppression count.

steps.title: File the suppression run record against the campaign
sop: Attach the run log with counts per rule to the campaign record.
Attach the spot-check result and the source refresh timestamps.
Confirm the record is retrievable for audit.
Done when the suppression evidence is filed against the campaign.
verify: Retrieve the filed run log from the campaign record.
Pass when the filed log shows counts removed by each suppression rule.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customer and prospect records meeting the agreed segment definition for the campaign.
generic.In-scope period: The selection run date, using the governed marts as at that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Channel fields required for the campaign are present and valid on every retained row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Output row count reconciles to the saved selection query control totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Saved selection query, run date and control totals registered with the audience extract.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows dropped for incomplete channel fields are written to a reject file with the reason.
generic.Test population: The loaded campaign audience extract produced by the selection query.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The list fails if duplicate contacts remain or the count does not match the query control total.
generic.Exception handling path: Reject-file rows are reviewed for data fixes rather than being force-loaded into the campaign.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The list is accepted when de-duplication passes and counts reconcile to the query.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse audience extract folder with the saved query and control totals.

steps.title: Write the selection query against the governed marts
sop: Write the query against the governed customer and prospect marts.
Use the agreed segment definition rather than a local spreadsheet extract.
Save the query with a name tied to the campaign.
Done when the saved query returns the intended segment.
verify: Check the query sources are governed marts only.
Pass when no part of the selection comes from a local extract.

steps.title: Apply the eligibility filters
sop: Filter on product held, tenure and state licensing footprint.
Exclude segments the product is not approved to be marketed to.
Record the filters applied on the campaign record.
Done when all eligibility filters are applied and recorded.
verify: Check the licensing footprint against the product approval list.
Pass when no ineligible state remains in the selection.

steps.title: Check required-field completeness by channel
sop: Check email present and valid for email, mobile present for SMS, address present for direct mail.
Drop incomplete rows to a reject file with the failing field named.
Record the reject counts by field.
Done when the reject file lists every incomplete row with its reason.
verify: Sample the retained rows for the required channel fields.
Pass when every retained row has valid identifiers for its intended channels.

steps.title: De-duplicate at household and contact level
sop: Apply the golden record rules to identify duplicate contacts and households.
Retain one record per person and one per household where the rule requires it.
Record the duplicate count removed.
Done when de-duplication has run and the count is recorded.
verify: Run a duplicate check on the output by contact key.
Pass when no duplicate contact record remains in the audience.

steps.title: Reconcile the output count to the query control totals
sop: Compare the output row count to the query control totals.
Investigate and explain any difference before release.
Record the reconciliation on the campaign record.
Done when the reconciliation shows no unexplained difference.
verify: Re-run the query count and compare to the extract.
Pass when the extract count matches the query control total.

steps.title: Register the list with its query definition and run date
sop: Register the audience extract with the saved query name and run date.
Attach the control totals and the reject file.
Store the registration against the campaign record.
Done when the list is registered with its query and run date.
verify: Retrieve the registration entry for the campaign.
Pass when the extract, saved query, run date and control totals are all retrievable.

steps.title: Hand the list to suppression
sop: Confirm the list is final and no further selection changes are pending.
Hand the registered extract to the suppression run.
Record the handover time and the row count handed over.
Done when suppression has acknowledged the handover count.
verify: Compare the handover count to the registered extract count.
Pass when the counts match at handover.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete campaign plan covering objectives, audience, offers, channels, creative and budget.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight dates plus the stated measurement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan sections carry KPIs, audience counts, budget, flight dates and named channel owners.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Audience counts in the plan match the final post-suppression list counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Compiled plan filed in the campaign folder with version and compile date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Creative listed without an approval reference is logged and removed from the plan until approved.
generic.Test population: Every section and creative item listed in the compiled plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The plan fails if any creative lacks an approval reference or audience counts do not match.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatched counts are corrected against the suppression run before the plan circulates.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The plan is accepted when it is complete and circulated to the sign-off group.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint campaign folder holding the compiled plan and attachments.

steps.title: Assemble the plan sections
sop: Compile objective and KPIs, audience and segment counts, offer and message map.
Compile channel mix and cadence, creative inventory, budget and forecast.
Use the standard campaign plan template.
Done when every required plan section is populated.
verify: Check the plan against the template section list.
Pass when no required section is missing from the compiled plan.

steps.title: Attach compliance approval references for every creative
sop: List every creative asset in the plan with its approval reference.
Attach the approved targeting criteria record.
Remove any creative with no approval reference from the plan.
Done when every listed creative carries an approval reference.
verify: Count creatives listed against approval references attached.
Pass when no creative appears in the plan without an approval reference.

steps.title: Reconcile plan audience counts to the suppression output
sop: Compare the plan audience counts to the final post-suppression list counts.
Correct the plan where the counts differ.
Record the reconciliation date and the counts used.
Done when the plan counts match the post-suppression counts.
verify: Re-check two segment counts against the suppression run log.
Pass when the plan counts equal the final post-suppression counts.

steps.title: Set flight dates, measurement window and channel owners
sop: Set the flight dates for each channel execution.
Set the measurement window for the KPIs.
Name the owner for each channel execution.
Done when dates, window and owners are set for every channel.
verify: Check each channel line for dates and a named owner.
Pass when no channel execution is left without an owner or a date.

steps.title: Load the plan into the marketing automation platform record
sop: Populate the campaign record with the plan dates, KPIs and budget.
Link the creative inventory and approval references.
Confirm the platform record matches the compiled plan.
Done when the platform campaign record reflects the plan.
verify: Compare the platform record fields against the plan.
Pass when no field in the platform record contradicts the plan.

steps.title: File the compiled plan in the campaign folder
sop: File the plan in the Microsoft 365 / SharePoint campaign folder with a version number.
Attach the audience counts, approvals and forecast.
Record the compile date.
Done when the plan and attachments are filed.
verify: Open the filed plan and check the attachments.
Pass when the filed plan carries KPIs, audience counts, budget and approval references.

steps.title: Circulate the plan to the sign-off group
sop: Circulate the filed plan to the sign-off group with a response date.
Answer questions raised and record any plan amendments.
Confirm the plan is ready to route for formal sign-off.
Done when the sign-off group has the final compiled plan.
verify: Check the circulation list against the sign-off group.
Pass when every sign-off group member has received the final plan.

generic.Defined scope/population: The campaign objective, its measurable KPIs and the full campaign budget by cost line.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight plus the KPI measurement window stated at objective setting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI has a numeric target, a baseline and a measurement window on the campaign record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Budget lines sum to the total and the total sits within the approved plan allocation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved budget and KPI targets stored on the campaign record with approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Budgets exceeding delegated authority are logged and routed to the higher approver.
generic.Test population: The campaign record's KPI set and budget lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The campaign fails to move to build with an unapproved budget or a KPI lacking a numeric target.
generic.Exception handling path: KPIs without a measurable definition are reworked before the budget is routed for approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Objectives are accepted when every KPI has a target, baseline and window and the budget is approved.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint campaign folder plus the campaign record holding the approval.

steps.title: State the campaign objective and translate it into KPIs
sop: State the campaign objective in business terms.
Translate it into measurable KPIs such as leads, quotes started, policies bound and acquisition cost.
Remove any objective that cannot be measured.
Done when every objective maps to at least one measurable KPI.
verify: Check each KPI can be sourced from a governed dataset.
Pass when no stated objective lacks a measurable KPI.

steps.title: Set numeric targets, baselines and measurement windows
sop: Set the numeric target for each KPI.
Record the current baseline from the BI/reporting platform.
Set the measurement window for each KPI.
Done when every KPI has a target, baseline and window.
verify: Check the baseline source and date for each KPI.
Pass when no KPI is left without a numeric target.

steps.title: Build the budget by cost line
sop: Build lines for media spend, creative production, agency fees, data costs and event or print costs.
Attach the quotes or rate cards behind each line.
Sum the lines to the campaign total.
Done when every cost line is populated and summed.
verify: Re-add the lines against the stated total.
Pass when the budget lines sum exactly to the campaign total.

steps.title: Check the total against the approved plan allocation
sop: Compare the campaign total against the approved marketing plan allocation.
Identify whether the total exceeds the delegated authority limit.
Record the comparison on the campaign record.
Done when the allocation check result is recorded.
verify: Check the allocation figure against the approved marketing plan.
Pass when the total sits within the allocation or is flagged for escalation.

steps.title: Route budgets above the delegated limit for approval
sop: Review campaigns whose total exceeds the delegated authority limit.
Approve, reduce or decline the requested total.
Record the decision, approver and date.
Done when every escalated budget has a recorded decision.
verify: Check the approval record against the delegated authority matrix.
Pass when no over-limit budget proceeds without the higher approval.

steps.title: Record approved budget and KPI targets on the campaign record
sop: Record the approved budget figure and each KPI target on the campaign record.
Link the approval evidence to the record.
Confirm the record is visible to the reporting platform for tracking.
Done when the record carries the approved budget and all KPI targets.
verify: Open the campaign record and check the budget and targets.
Pass when no campaign moves to build with an unapproved budget.

steps.title: Confirm actuals can be tracked against the targets
sop: Confirm each KPI has a reporting source that will produce actuals.
Confirm the measurement window is configured in the reporting platform.
Record the tracking configuration against the campaign.
Done when every KPI has a configured actuals source.
verify: Run a test read of one KPI from the reporting source.
Pass when every KPI returns a value from its configured source.

generic.Defined scope/population: The contact population meeting the campaign's attribute criteria across customers and prospects.
generic.In-scope period: The audience definition run date, with counts stated as at that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The criteria set records segment code, product held, tenure, geography and trigger where used.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The sized audience count reconciles to the criteria query run against the warehouse.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria set and resulting count recorded on the campaign record with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States where the product is not approved are logged as excluded with the reason.
generic.Test population: The defined audience and the state or territory list it covers.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The definition fails where any included territory lacks product approval for sale.
generic.Exception handling path: Unapproved territories are removed from the criteria before the audience is sized as final.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Definition is accepted when the criteria are reproducible and the count supports the test design.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse query store plus the campaign record holding the criteria and count.

steps.title: State the target audience in business terms
sop: Write the audience description agreed with the campaign owner.
State the customer need or trigger the campaign addresses.
Circulate the description for confirmation before translating it.
Done when the business description is confirmed by the campaign owner.
verify: Check the description against the campaign objective.
Pass when the campaign owner has confirmed the audience description.

steps.title: Translate the description into attribute criteria
sop: Translate the description into segment code, product held, tenure, geography and life-stage trigger.
Write the criteria so another analyst could reproduce the selection.
Record the criteria set on the campaign record.
Done when the criteria set fully expresses the business description.
verify: Have a second analyst read the criteria against the description.
Pass when the criteria reproduce the intended audience without interpretation.

steps.title: Size the audience against the warehouse
sop: Run the criteria against the enterprise data warehouse.
Record the resulting count and the run date.
Compare the count against the planned test cells and forecast response.
Done when the audience is sized and compared to the test design.
verify: Re-run the criteria and compare the count.
Pass when the count supports the planned test cells and forecast.

steps.title: Confirm product approval in every included territory
sop: List the states and territories present in the audience.
Check each against the product approval and licensing record.
Remove territories where the product is not approved for sale.
Done when every remaining territory holds product approval.
verify: Compare the territory list against the product approval record.
Pass when no territory in the audience lacks product approval for sale.

steps.title: Apply vulnerable-customer and age-based handling rules
sop: Identify where the product or channel requires additional care rules.
Apply the vulnerable-customer and age-based handling rules to the criteria.
Record which rules were applied and why.
Done when the applicable care rules are applied to the audience.
verify: Check the applied rules against the product care requirements.
Pass when every required care rule is applied to the audience criteria.

steps.title: Document the criteria and count on the campaign record
sop: Record the final criteria set, the count and the run date.
Attach the saved query reference so the selection is reproducible.
Confirm the record is visible to the list build step.
Done when the campaign record carries criteria, count and query reference.
verify: Retrieve the criteria from the campaign record and re-run them.
Pass when the re-run reproduces the recorded count within tolerance.

steps.title: Review the audience with the marketing manager
sop: Review the audience definition, size and territory coverage.
Challenge any criterion that widens the audience beyond the objective.
Approve the audience for list build.
Done when the manager has approved the audience definition.
verify: Check the approval is recorded on the campaign record.
Pass when no list build starts without a recorded audience approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All contacts assigned to test cells and the reserved holdout control group for the campaign.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight and the read date registered before launch.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every contact record carries a test cell code including the holdout flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cell counts sum to the released audience with the holdout reserved and excluded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Test design registered before launch with random seed, sample sizes and read date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells failing minimum size are logged and merged or dropped before launch.
generic.Test population: The full assigned audience including the holdout control group.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The design fails if a holdout contact appears in any deployment audience.
generic.Exception handling path: Contacts found in both holdout and deployment are removed from deployment before send.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Design is accepted when the success metric, threshold and read date are registered pre-launch.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse cell assignment table and the campaign test design record.

steps.title: Define the single variable under test per cell
sop: Name the one variable being tested in each cell such as subject line, offer, creative or landing page.
Hold every other element constant across the cells.
Record the variable and the constants for each cell.
Done when each cell varies on exactly one element.
verify: Compare the cell definitions element by element.
Pass when no cell varies on more than one element.

steps.title: Size the cells against the expected response rate
sop: Use the expected response rate to compute the sample needed for significance.
Record the minimum detectable effect for the planned flight.
Adjust or merge cells that cannot reach significance.
Done when every retained cell is sized to reach significance.
verify: Recompute one cell size from the stated inputs.
Pass when every retained cell meets its minimum sample size.

steps.title: Reserve and lock the holdout control group
sop: Randomly assign a holdout control group that receives no contact.
Lock the holdout before the audience is released.
Record the holdout size and the lock timestamp.
Done when the holdout is reserved and locked.
verify: Check the holdout lock timestamp precedes audience release.
Pass when the holdout was locked before any audience release.

steps.title: Assign contacts to cells with a reproducible seed
sop: Assign contacts to cells using a recorded random seed.
Write the cell code onto each contact record.
Store the seed with the test design so assignment can be reproduced.
Done when every contact carries a cell code and the seed is stored.
verify: Re-run the assignment with the stored seed on a sample.
Pass when every contact carries a test cell code including the holdout flag.

steps.title: Register the success metric, threshold and read date
sop: Register the single success metric for the test.
Register the significance threshold and the read date before launch.
Lock the registration so the result cannot be chosen after the fact.
Done when the metric, threshold and read date are registered pre-launch.
verify: Check the registration timestamp against the launch time.
Pass when the registration predates the campaign launch.

steps.title: Exclude the holdout from every deployment audience
sop: Apply the holdout flag as an exclusion on every deployment audience.
Run a check for holdout contacts inside each deployment list.
Remove any found before the send is armed.
Done when no deployment audience contains a holdout contact.
verify: Join the deployment audiences to the holdout flag.
Pass when no contact in the holdout appears in any deployment audience.

steps.title: Confirm the cell design with the marketing specialist
sop: Walk the cell design, sizes and holdout with the campaign specialist.
Confirm the creative variants match the cells they are assigned to.
Record the confirmation on the test design record.
Done when the design is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Compare cell codes to the assigned creative variants.
Pass when every cell maps to the creative variant it was designed for.

generic.Defined scope/population: The planned audience counts by cell and channel used to forecast campaign outcomes.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight and the measurement window used for the projected conversions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The forecast records reach, response, conversion, acquisition cost and stated assumptions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forecast audience counts reconcile to the planned cell counts on the campaign record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Forecast stored on the campaign record with the benchmark source and calculation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Benchmarks unavailable for a channel or segment are logged with the proxy used instead.
generic.Test population: Every forecast line by channel and segment in the campaign forecast.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A forecast line fails where no historical benchmark source is documented behind it.
generic.Exception handling path: Lines without a benchmark are recalculated using a documented proxy or removed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Forecast is accepted when assumptions and a low, expected and high range are stated.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint campaign folder plus the campaign record holding the forecast.

steps.title: Pull historical benchmark rates from the BI/reporting platform
sop: Pull response, quote and conversion rates for comparable campaigns by channel and segment.
Record the campaigns used and their date range.
Note where no comparable benchmark exists.
Done when benchmark rates are assembled for every planned channel and segment.
verify: Check the comparability of the campaigns selected.
Pass when every benchmark rate cites the source campaigns and period.

steps.title: Apply benchmark rates to the planned audience counts
sop: Apply the benchmark rates to the planned counts by cell.
Project reach, responses, quotes and policies bound.
Reconcile the input counts to the campaign record cell counts.
Done when projections exist for every planned cell.
verify: Compare the input counts to the campaign record.
Pass when the forecast counts match the planned cell counts.

steps.title: Calculate projected acquisition cost and return
sop: Use the approved budget and the projected policies bound to compute acquisition cost.
Apply the average premium or margin per policy for the product.
Compute the projected return on the campaign.
Done when acquisition cost and return are calculated.
verify: Recompute acquisition cost from budget and projected policies.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the published forecast.

generic.Test population: Every material published to the producer portal for the campaign.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Distribution fails if a superseded version remains downloadable after the new version goes live.
generic.Exception handling path: Superseded versions found live are removed immediately and the removal is logged.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Distribution is accepted when eligible producers can access the material and the log is complete.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal listing history plus the CRM campaign distribution log.

steps.title: Publish approved materials to the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Publish the approved materials with campaign name, usage rules and expiry date visible.
Attach the version and approval reference to the listing.
Record the publication timestamp.
Done when the materials are live with usage rules and expiry visible.
verify: Open the listing and check the displayed fields.
Pass when the listing shows usage rules, version and expiry date.

steps.title: Scope portal visibility to eligible producers
sop: Restrict visibility to producers appointed for the campaign products and states.
Test the scoping with an eligible and an ineligible producer profile.
Correct the scoping if either test fails.
Done when only eligible producers can see the materials.
verify: View the listing from an ineligible producer profile.
Pass when ineligible producers cannot download the material.

steps.title: Notify the distribution list through Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the notification with the portal link and the usage rules.
State the expiry date and the campaign flight dates.
Record the send list and timestamp.
Done when the notification has reached the full distribution list.
verify: Compare the send list to the eligible producer list.
Pass when no eligible producer is missing from the notification.

steps.title: Confirm delivery and download counts
sop: Pull delivery and download counts from the portal and the email platform.
Compare against the expected eligible producer count.
Follow up with producers showing no delivery.
Done when the counts are compared and follow-ups raised.
verify: Recompute the download rate against eligible producers.
Pass when every non-delivery is followed up or explained.

steps.title: Remove superseded versions at the moment of go-live
sop: Identify any prior version of the same material on the portal.
Remove it at the moment the new version goes live.
Record the removal timestamp.
Done when no superseded version remains on the portal.
verify: Search the portal for prior versions of the material.
Pass when no superseded version of the campaign material is downloadable.

steps.title: Log distribution against the campaign record in the CRM
sop: Log the distribution date, version and recipient list against the campaign.
Attach the portal listing reference.
Confirm the log is retrievable for the advertising audit trail.
Done when the distribution log is complete against the campaign record.
verify: Retrieve the distribution log from the campaign record.
Pass when the log shows date, version and recipient list.

steps.title: Confirm distribution completeness with the marketing specialist
sop: Review the published materials against the approved campaign asset list.
Confirm no approved material is missing from the portal.
Sign the distribution as complete.
Done when the distribution is signed as complete.
verify: Compare the portal listings to the approved asset list.
Pass when every approved material for the campaign is published.

generic.Defined scope/population: The digital components of the campaign covering email sends, paid placements, landing pages and retargeting.
generic.In-scope period: The launch window and the first delivery wave of the campaign flight.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Campaign record shows QA sign-off, compliance approval and suppression completion before activation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: First-wave send count reconciles to the released audience count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Launch confirmation recorded with activation timestamps per component.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Components failing first-wave checks are paused and logged with the fault and the fix.
generic.Test population: Every digital component activated for the campaign.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Launch fails if a delivered email lacks a working unsubscribe link or sender identification block.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed delivery check holds the next wave until the fault is corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Launch is accepted when responses flow into the CRM with the campaign source code.
generic.Evidence location: Marketing automation platform launch log and the campaign record in the CRM.

steps.title: Confirm pre-launch gates on the campaign record
sop: Check QA sign-off, compliance approval and suppression completion are all recorded.
Hold the launch if any gate is missing.
Record the gate check with a timestamp.
Done when all three gates show as complete.
verify: Open the campaign record and check all three gates.
Pass when no component is enabled with a gate outstanding.

steps.title: Activate the digital components in the planned sequence
sop: Activate email sends, paid placements, landing pages and retargeting audiences in order.
Record the activation timestamp per component.
Hold any component whose dependency has not activated.
Done when every planned component is activated in sequence.
verify: Compare activation order to the planned sequence.
Pass when every component activated in its planned order.

steps.title: Verify first-wave delivery
sop: Compare the send count against the released audience count.
Confirm tracking parameters fire on the delivered links.
Confirm landing pages resolve from the live links.
Done when first-wave delivery is verified across components.
verify: Recompute send count against audience count.
Pass when the send count matches the released audience count.

steps.title: Check the unsubscribe and identification blocks in delivered mail
sop: Open the delivered email in a seed inbox rather than in preview.
Click the unsubscribe link and confirm it processes.
Confirm the postal identification block renders.
Done when both elements are confirmed in the delivered message.
verify: Repeat the check on a second delivered message.
Pass when no delivered email is missing a working unsubscribe or identification block.

steps.title: Confirm responses flow into the CRM with the source code
sop: Submit a test response through a live path.
Confirm the record arrives in the CRM with the campaign source code.
Correct the integration if the code is missing.
Done when a live test response lands correctly in the CRM.
verify: Open the test response record in the CRM.
Pass when the response carries the correct campaign source code.

steps.title: Record the launch confirmation on the campaign record
sop: Record activation timestamps, send counts and the delivery checks.
Attach the seed inbox evidence.
Notify the campaign channel that the campaign is live.
Done when the launch confirmation is recorded and announced.
verify: Open the launch confirmation record.
Pass when the record shows first-wave send count and activation timestamps.

steps.title: Review the launch with the marketing manager
sop: Review delivery, early engagement and any component held.
Agree whether to release the next wave.
Record the decision on the campaign record.
Done when the next-wave decision is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded decision against the delivery evidence.
Pass when no next wave is released with a failed delivery check open.

generic.Defined scope/population: All partners holding a co-op entitlement and every allocation and drawdown against it.
generic.In-scope period: The co-op programme year with period-end reconciliation against finance-posted spend.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ledger rows carry partner, entitlement, opening balance, allocations, drawdowns and closing balance.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ledger closing balances reconcile to finance-posted co-op spend at period end.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Co-op ledger extract filed with the period-end date and the reconciliation record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances against finance are logged with the cause and the correction applied.
generic.Test population: Every partner ledger line and every drawdown recorded in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A drawdown fails where the activity type sits outside the approved co-op policy.
generic.Exception handling path: Ineligible spend requests are rejected before funds are committed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Period close is accepted when every variance is explained and balances are notified to partners.
generic.Evidence location: CRM co-op ledger records plus the document management repository partner agreement folder.

steps.title: Calculate each partner's co-op entitlement
sop: Apply the published entitlement formula to each partner's qualifying volume.
Check the result against the partner agreement terms.
Record the entitlement per partner in the ledger.
Done when every partner has a calculated and checked entitlement.
verify: Recompute one partner's entitlement from the formula.
Pass when the recomputed entitlement matches the ledger.

steps.title: Record opening balances, allocations and drawdowns
sop: Record the opening balance per partner in the co-op ledger.
Record approved allocations and each drawdown as it occurs.
Keep the ledger current rather than reconstructing it at period end.
Done when the ledger shows a running balance per partner.
verify: Recompute a partner balance from its transactions.
Pass when the running balance equals opening plus allocations minus drawdowns.

steps.title: Approve spend requests against eligible activity types
sop: Check each spend request against the approved co-op activity types.
Reject ineligible categories before funds are committed.
Record the approval or rejection with the reason.
Done when every request has a recorded decision.
verify: Sample approved drawdowns against the activity policy.
Pass when no drawdown is recorded against an activity outside the policy.

steps.title: Reconcile the ledger to finance-posted spend
sop: Pull the finance-posted co-op spend for the period from the BI/reporting platform.
Compare it line by line against the ledger drawdowns.
Investigate and record every variance.
Done when the reconciliation is complete with variances explained.
verify: Re-run the comparison after corrections.
Pass when every variance is explained or corrected.

steps.title: Report unused balances and expiry dates to partners
sop: Identify partners with unused balances approaching expiry.
Notify them with sufficient notice before the entitlement lapses.
Record the notification date per partner.
Done when every partner with an expiring balance has been notified.
verify: Compare notifications to the expiring balance list.
Pass when no entitlement lapses without a prior notification.

steps.title: File the ledger extract in the document management repository
sop: Export the period-end ledger with balances per partner.
File it with the reconciliation record and the period date.
Link it from the co-op programme folder.
Done when the period-end ledger is filed.
verify: Retrieve the filed ledger for the period.
Pass when the filed ledger shows entitlement, allocations, drawdowns and closing balance per partner.

steps.title: Review the co-op position with the marketing manager
sop: Review entitlements, utilisation and expiring balances.
Agree reallocation of unused funds where the policy allows.
Record the agreed decisions against the ledger.
Done when the period position is reviewed and decisions recorded.
verify: Check each reallocation against the co-op policy.
Pass when every reallocation decision is recorded with an approver.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every partner participating in the co-op campaign and the activity attributed to them.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight plus the agreed attribution window for quotes and bound policies.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each partner row carries materials used, sends or impressions, leads, quotes and policies bound.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Leads attributed across partners sum to the campaign lead total in the CRM.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-partner performance record stored against the co-op ledger entry with the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Attribution exceptions are documented with the rule applied and the partner credited.
generic.Test population: All leads and bound policies attributed to co-op partners in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Measurement fails if a lead is counted against two partners under the attribution rule.
generic.Exception handling path: Double-counted leads are re-attributed to a single partner before the results are published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Results are accepted when cost per lead and return on co-op spend are stated per partner.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI co-op performance report and the CRM campaign attribution records.

steps.title: Pull per-partner activity data from the CRM
sop: Pull materials used, impressions or sends, leads, quotes and policies bound per partner.
Record the extract date and the attribution window applied.
Flag partners with no recorded activity.
Done when every partner has an activity row or a no-activity flag.
verify: Compare the partner list to the campaign participation record.
Pass when no participating partner is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Apply the agreed attribution rule
sop: Apply the attribution rule so a lead credits one partner and one campaign.
Document exceptions where the rule cannot resolve a single owner.
Re-attribute leads found against two partners.
Done when every lead has a single attributed partner.
verify: Run a duplicate attribution check across partners.
Pass when no lead is double-counted across two partners.

steps.title: Calculate cost per lead and return on co-op spend
sop: Divide co-op spend by leads and by bound policies for each partner.
Calculate return on co-op spend using written premium or margin.
Record the ratios per partner.
Done when every partner has cost and return figures.
verify: Recompute one partner's ratios from source figures.
Pass when the recomputed ratios match the published figures.

steps.title: Rank partners against the peer benchmark in Power BI
sop: Rank partners on cost per bound policy against the peer benchmark.
Flag partners whose spend produced no measurable pipeline.
Record the ranking and flags in the report.
Done when every partner is ranked or flagged.
verify: Check the benchmark definition used in the ranking.
Pass when every partner appears in the ranking or the flagged list.

steps.title: Record results against the co-op ledger entry
sop: Write the per-partner results back against the co-op ledger entry.
Link the report so funding decisions can cite the evidence.
Record the write-back date.
Done when every ledger entry carries its performance result.
verify: Open a ledger entry and check the linked result.
Pass when every partner ledger entry carries leads, policies and return.

steps.title: Review attribution exceptions with the insights lead
sop: Review the documented attribution exceptions and the rule applied.
Confirm the credited partner for each exception.
Record the confirmation against the exception log.
Done when every exception has a confirmed attribution.
verify: Recount attributed leads against the campaign total.
Pass when attributed leads sum to the campaign lead total.

steps.title: Issue the per-partner performance view
sop: Issue the performance view to distribution leadership and the partners.
State the attribution rule applied on the report.
File the report with the campaign record.
Done when the report is issued and filed.
verify: Open the issued report and check the stated attribution rule.
Pass when no result is issued without the attribution rule stated.

generic.Defined scope/population: All co-branded materials submitted for compliance and legal review before producer distribution.
generic.In-scope period: The review window ahead of portal publication, with approvals valid to their expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each review record carries material reference, reviewer, decision, date and approval expiry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Materials submitted reconcile to approvals issued and to portal listings published.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval records stored in the compliance evidence repository with reviewer and expiry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Materials rejected are logged with the required change and the resubmission outcome.
generic.Test population: Every co-branded material available for download in the producer portal.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A material fails if the producer-editable zone can remove or obscure mandatory content.
generic.Exception handling path: Materials whose editable zone breaches the lock rules return to production for rebuild.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval requires the portal listing expiry to match the approval expiry date.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository co-branding approvals linked to the Broker & Agent Portal listing.

steps.title: Review the carrier-controlled content for claim substantiation
sop: Read the carrier content for misleading or unsubstantiated statements.
Check each claim against its stated source.
Mark findings against the specific line of copy.
Done when the carrier content has a recorded claim review.
verify: Open two cited sources and check they support the claims.
Pass when no approved material carries an unsourced claim.

steps.title: Test the producer-editable zone against the lock rules
sop: Attempt to remove or obscure the mandatory disclosures using the editable fields.
Attempt to remove the licence numbers and carrier identification.
Reject the material if any attempt succeeds.
Done when the editable zone is tested against all three targets.
verify: Repeat the removal test on the resubmitted version.
Pass when the editable zone cannot remove or obscure mandatory content.

steps.title: Check the partner is presented accurately
sop: Check the agency name and licence number are presented correctly.
Check the material states the producer is an independent producer where applicable.
Correct any presentation that implies the producer is the carrier.
Done when the partner presentation is verified.
verify: Read the rendered material as a consumer would.
Pass when no material implies the producer is the carrier.

steps.title: Confirm product, entity and state disclosures per jurisdiction
sop: List the jurisdictions the material will be distributed into.
Confirm product name, legal entity and state disclosures for each.
Reject the material where a jurisdiction is unsupported.
Done when disclosures are confirmed for every distribution jurisdiction.
verify: Compare the material against the disclosure library for two jurisdictions.
Pass when every distribution jurisdiction has correct disclosures.

steps.title: Record the approval with reviewer, date and expiry
sop: Record the decision per material with reviewer name and date.
Set the approval expiry date.
Store the record in the compliance evidence repository.
Done when every submitted material has a recorded decision.
verify: Open the approval record and check all four fields.
Pass when every approval record shows reviewer, date and expiry.

steps.title: Set the portal listing to expire on the approval date
sop: Set the Broker & Agent Portal listing expiry to match the approval expiry.
Confirm the listing withdraws automatically at expiry.
Record the listing configuration.
Done when the listing expiry matches the approval expiry.
verify: Compare the listing expiry to the approval expiry.
Pass when no co-branded material is downloadable past its approval expiry.

steps.title: Confirm the approved set with the marketing specialist
sop: Reconcile materials submitted, approved, rejected and published.
Chase resubmission for rejected materials.
Sign the review cycle as complete.
Done when every submitted material is approved, rejected or withdrawn.
verify: Compare portal listings to the approval register.
Pass when no portal listing lacks a matching live approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All co-op and channel marketing activities planned by segment, line of business and partner.
generic.In-scope period: The planning year, with the current quarter locked against unapproved additions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each activity carries partner, segment, line, month, budget, co-op split and named owners.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Activity budgets sum to a total within the approved marketing plan allocation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published calendar filed with version, publication date and the locked-quarter marker.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unfunded activities are logged and either funded or removed before publication.
generic.Test population: Every activity on the published co-op marketing calendar.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An activity fails if its budget is unfunded against the approved marketing plan.
generic.Exception handling path: Clashing activities on the same partner audience are rescheduled before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calendar is accepted when every activity has an owner, budget and co-op split.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint co-op planning folder holding the published calendar.

steps.title: Collect partner, segment and line priorities
sop: Collect the priorities from partners, segment owners and line-of-business leads.
Pull the co-op entitlement available for the year from the CRM.
Record the inputs against the planning cycle.
Done when priorities and available entitlement are recorded.
verify: Check the entitlement total against the co-op ledger.
Pass when the recorded entitlement matches the ledger total.

steps.title: Slot activities by month against fixed dates
sop: Slot activities against product launch dates, renewal peaks and event dates.
Avoid clashes on the same partner audience in the same window.
Record the slotting rationale where a clash was resolved.
Done when every activity has a month slot with no unresolved clash.
verify: Run a clash check by partner and audience.
Pass when no two activities clash on the same partner audience.

steps.title: Assign budget and co-op funding split per activity
sop: Assign the budget and the co-op funding split to each activity.
Total the committed spend and compare against the approved plan.
Cut or defer activities that exceed the allocation.
Done when the total sits within the approved plan allocation.
verify: Re-add the activity budgets against the allocation.
Pass when no calendar activity is unfunded against the approved plan.

steps.title: Name marketing and distribution owners per activity
sop: Name the marketing owner and the distribution owner for each activity.
Set the lead-time milestones for creative and compliance review.
Confirm owners accept the milestone dates.
Done when every activity has both owners and milestone dates.
verify: Check every activity row for two named owners.
Pass when no activity is left without an owner or milestone dates.

steps.title: Publish the calendar to distribution leadership and partners
sop: Publish the calendar to Microsoft 365 / SharePoint with a version number.
Circulate it to distribution leadership and the participating partners.
Record the publication date.
Done when the calendar is published and circulated.
verify: Open the published version and check the activity fields.
Pass when the published calendar shows owner, partner, budget and co-op split per activity.

steps.title: Lock the current quarter against unapproved additions
sop: Mark the current quarter as locked on the published calendar.
Require approval for any late addition.
Log approved late additions with the reason and funding source.
Done when the quarter is locked and the approval route is stated.
verify: Check late additions for a recorded approval.
Pass when no activity was added to the locked quarter without approval.

steps.title: Confirm the plan with distribution leadership
sop: Review the calendar coverage across segments, lines and partners.
Confirm the committed spend against the approved marketing budget.
Record the approval with name and date.
Done when the calendar carries a recorded approval.
verify: Check the approval record against the published version.
Pass when the published calendar version matches the approved version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every live channel marketing activity with engagement, lead and co-op spend tracking.
generic.In-scope period: The current tracking week, cumulative against the approved activity budget.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each tracker row carries activity, partner, engagement, leads, committed spend and actual spend.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracker lead counts reconcile to the CRM campaign report for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Weekly tracker published with the refresh timestamp and source platforms named.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Flagged activities are logged with the trigger, the owner and the action agreed.
generic.Test population: Every in-flight activity on the channel marketing calendar.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An activity fails where actual spend exceeds approved budget without a recorded approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Activities over 90% of budget or under 50% of lead target are escalated to the marketing manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The tracker is accepted when the current period is refreshed and flags are listed at the top.
generic.Evidence location: BI/reporting platform channel tracker plus the CRM activity and spend records.

steps.title: Refresh engagement metrics from the source platforms
sop: Refresh impressions, opens, clicks, downloads and event attendance per activity.
Confirm each source platform returned a complete period.
Record the refresh timestamp.
Done when every activity has refreshed engagement data.
verify: Check each source for missing days.
Pass when no activity is missing engagement data for the period.

steps.title: Pull leads and pipeline stage from the CRM
sop: Pull leads generated and their pipeline stage per activity.
Attribute each lead to the correct activity and partner.
Reconcile the lead total to the CRM campaign report.
Done when leads are attributed and reconciled.
verify: Compare the tracker lead total to the CRM campaign report.
Pass when the two lead totals reconcile.

steps.title: Post committed and actual co-op spend per activity
sop: Post committed and actual spend against each activity.
Calculate spend to date against the approved budget.
Flag any activity where actual exceeds approved budget.
Done when spend to date is posted for every activity.
verify: Recompute spend to date for one activity.
Pass when no activity shows actual spend over budget without a recorded approval.

steps.title: Flag activities breaching the alert thresholds
sop: Flag activities over 90% of budget.
Flag activities tracking below 50% of their lead target.
Attach the underlying figures to each flag.
Done when every breaching activity is flagged with its figures.
verify: Recheck the threshold calculations on the flagged set.
Pass when every activity breaching a threshold is flagged.

steps.title: Raise the flagged items to the marketing manager
sop: Review the flagged activities and their causes.
Agree the action of continue, adjust, pause or refund.
Record the agreed action and owner against each flag.
Done when every flagged item has an agreed action.
verify: Check each flag for an agreed action and owner.
Pass when no flagged item is left without an action.

steps.title: Publish the weekly tracker to distribution leadership
sop: Publish the tracker with the flagged items listed at the top.
Include engagement, leads and spend versus budget per activity.
Record the publication timestamp.
Done when the tracker is published for the current week.
verify: Open the published tracker and check the flag section.
Pass when the tracker shows engagement, leads and spend versus budget per activity.

steps.title: Carry actions forward to the next tracking cycle
sop: Carry open actions into the next tracker with their due dates.
Close actions once the evidence is recorded.
Escalate actions overdue by more than one cycle.
Done when every open action is carried forward or closed.
verify: Compare open actions between consecutive trackers.
Pass when no action is dropped without being closed or escalated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Completed campaigns whose calendar entries require closure and results capture.
generic.In-scope period: The closure window after the campaign end date and the results package issue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calendar entry carries actual start and end dates, final spend and headline outcomes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final spend on the entry reconciles to the results package and the co-op ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Results package attached to the calendar entry with its issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Campaigns left in flight past their end date are logged and closed or extended formally.
generic.Test population: Every completed campaign on the marketing calendar for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Closure fails if a completed campaign remains in an in-flight status on the calendar.
generic.Exception handling path: Entries missing results are held open with an owner and a due date rather than closed blind.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure is accepted when actual dates, final spend and the results package are all attached.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint marketing calendar entry with the attached results package.

steps.title: Set the campaign entry status to complete
sop: Set the calendar entry status to complete for campaigns past their end date.
Record the actual start and end dates against the planned dates.
Note the reason for any date variance.
Done when the entry shows complete status with actual dates.
verify: Query the calendar for completed campaigns still in flight status.
Pass when no completed campaign remains in an in-flight status.

steps.title: Attach the results package and final spend
sop: Attach the issued results package to the calendar entry.
Record the final spend figure from the co-op ledger and finance postings.
Reconcile the figure against the results package.
Done when the package and final spend are attached.
verify: Compare the recorded spend to the results package figure.
Pass when the entry spend matches the results package.

steps.title: Record the headline outcome against target
sop: Record leads, bound policies and cost per acquisition on the entry.
Show each against its planned target.
Note the variance driver for material misses.
Done when the headline outcomes are recorded against target.
verify: Check the recorded outcomes against the results package.
Pass when the outcomes on the entry match the results package.

steps.title: Log learnings and recommended changes
sop: Log what worked and what did not against the entry.
State the recommended changes for the next cycle.
Tag the learnings so planning can retrieve them.
Done when learnings and recommendations are logged.
verify: Search the planning tag for the logged learnings.
Pass when the learnings are retrievable from the planning tag.

steps.title: Release the slot and unspent budget for reallocation
sop: Release the calendar slot back for reallocation.
Return unspent budget into the available pool.
Record the released amount and the date.
Done when the slot and unspent budget are released.
verify: Compare released budget to approved minus actual spend.
Pass when the released amount equals the unspent balance.

steps.title: Update the campaign status in the marketing automation platform
sop: Set the campaign to closed in the marketing automation platform.
Confirm no journey or scheduled send remains active.
Record the closure timestamp.
Done when the platform shows the campaign closed.
verify: Query the platform for active steps under the campaign.
Pass when no active journey or scheduled send remains.

steps.title: Confirm closure with the marketing manager
sop: Review the closed entry, outcomes and released budget.
Confirm the learnings are usable for the next planning cycle.
Sign the closure on the calendar entry.
Done when the entry closure is signed.
verify: Check the entry for a closure sign-off.
Pass when the calendar entry is marked complete with actual dates, spend and package attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All co-op reimbursement claims submitted by partners in the claim period.
generic.In-scope period: The claim submission window defined in the co-op policy for the activity period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each claim carries partner, activity, invoice, proof of performance and claimed amount.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved claim amounts reconcile to the drawdowns posted on the co-op ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof of performance and invoices filed against the claim with submission date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected line items are logged with the ineligibility reason and communicated to the partner.
generic.Test population: Every claim validated for reimbursement in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A claim fails where the invoice number duplicates one already approved for reimbursement.
generic.Exception handling path: Claims with insufficient proof are returned to the partner rather than part-paid.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is accepted when proof and invoice are attached and the decision is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository claim folder linked to the CRM co-op ledger entry.

steps.title: Check the claim against the co-op ledger
sop: Check the claimed activity was approved and remains eligible.
Check the partner has sufficient entitlement remaining.
Check the claim falls inside the submission window.
Done when the ledger checks are recorded against the claim.
verify: Compare the claim to the ledger entitlement balance.
Pass when no claim exceeding the remaining entitlement is approved.

steps.title: Verify the proof of performance supplied
sop: Check the tear sheet, screenshot, invoice or attendance list evidences the claimed activity.
Check the evidence date matches the claimed activity date.
Return claims where the evidence does not match.
Done when the proof is verified or the claim is returned.
verify: Compare the evidence date and content to the claim.
Pass when every validated claim has matching proof of performance attached.

steps.title: Confirm the material used carries a valid approval
sop: Check the material used holds a valid compliance approval reference.
Compare the material used against the approved version for alteration.
Reject claims where the material was altered.
Done when the material check is recorded against the claim.
verify: Compare the claimed material to the approved version.
Pass when no claim is approved for an altered or unapproved material.

steps.title: Check the invoice against eligible cost categories
sop: Check each invoice line against the eligible cost categories.
Apply the agreed reimbursement percentage to eligible lines.
Reject ineligible line items with the reason stated.
Done when every invoice line is assessed.
verify: Recompute the reimbursable amount from the eligible lines.
Pass when the approved amount matches the recomputed eligible total.

steps.title: Screen for duplicate submissions
sop: Check the invoice number and evidence against previously approved claims.
Reject any duplicate submission.
