steps.title: Route changed claims for compliance re-approval
sop: Identify any product claim, rate or statistic changed in the copy.
Confirm the source and route the change for re-approval.
Hold publication until the re-approval is recorded.
Done when every changed claim has a recorded re-approval.
verify: Check the re-approval reference for each changed claim.
Pass when no changed product claim is published without a recorded re-approval.

steps.title: Update alt text, internal links, canonical and structured data
sop: Update image alt text and the internal links on the page.
Set the canonical tag correctly for the page.
Update the structured data markup.
Done when all four elements are updated.
verify: Validate the structured data and canonical on the staged page.
Pass when the canonical resolves correctly and the markup validates.

steps.title: Publish the change to the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Publish the updated page to the live environment.
Confirm the live page shows the new title and description.
Record the publish timestamp.
Done when the change is live and confirmed.
verify: Open the live URL and check the updated elements.
Pass when the updated title, meta description and canonical are live on the target URL.

steps.title: Record before and after values in the change log
sop: Record the before and after values for each changed element.
Attach the re-approval references where claims changed.
File the log in the document management repository.
Done when the change log entry is complete.
verify: Open the change log entry and check the values.
Pass when the entry records before and after values for every changed element.

steps.title: Request re-indexing of the updated URL
sop: Request re-indexing for the updated URL.
Confirm the request was accepted.
Record the request date for later ranking comparison.
Done when re-indexing has been requested and recorded.
verify: Check the indexing status after the request.
Pass when the updated URL shows as re-crawled or queued.

generic.Defined scope/population: The QA-passed campaign landing pages being promoted to the live environment.
generic.In-scope period: The publication window before the campaign launch date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each page record carries QA sign-off, compliance approval reference, version and publish time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pages published reconcile to the pages listed on the campaign landing page inventory.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Publish time and version recorded against the campaign record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pages failing a live check are unpublished and logged with the fault and the fix.
generic.Test population: Every campaign landing page promoted to live.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Publication fails where a live page is missing the privacy notice link or a required disclosure.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed live checks trigger an immediate unpublish until the page is corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication is accepted when the form submits end to end and tags fire on the live page.
generic.Evidence location: Customer Self-Service Portal publication record linked to the campaign record.

steps.title: Confirm QA sign-off and compliance approval
sop: Check the page carries QA sign-off and a compliance approval reference.
Hold the page if either is missing.
Record the check against the page record.
Done when both gates are confirmed present.
verify: Open the page record and check both references.
Pass when no page is promoted without QA and compliance references.

steps.title: Publish to the live environment and verify the URL
sop: Publish the page to live.
Open the URL and confirm it resolves over HTTPS.
Confirm there is no redirect loop or certificate warning.
Done when the live URL resolves cleanly.
verify: Load the URL in a clean browser session.
Pass when the page resolves over HTTPS with no certificate warning.

steps.title: Test the form end to end into the CRM
sop: Submit the form with a test lead on the live page.
Confirm the lead arrives in the CRM.
Confirm the campaign source code is populated on the record.
Done when the test lead arrives correctly coded.
verify: Open the test lead in the CRM.
Pass when the test lead carries the correct campaign source code.

steps.title: Confirm tracking tags, consent banner and privacy link
sop: Confirm the tracking tags fire on the live page.
Confirm the consent banner behaves correctly before tags fire.
Confirm the privacy notice link is present and resolves.
Done when all three checks pass on the live page.
verify: Re-check the tag firing after declining consent.
Pass when no live page is missing the privacy notice link.

steps.title: Confirm the required product disclosures render
sop: Check the required product disclosures are visible on the live page.
Confirm they are not hidden behind an additional interaction.
Unpublish the page where a disclosure is missing.
Done when disclosures are confirmed visible on the live page.
verify: View the page as a first-time visitor.
Pass when every required product disclosure is visible without extra interaction.

steps.title: Confirm the indexing state is as intended
sop: Check whether the page should be indexable or noindexed.
Confirm the live directive matches the intent.
Correct any mismatch immediately.
Done when the indexing directive matches the intent.
verify: Read the live robots directive on the page.
Pass when the live directive matches the recorded intent.

steps.title: Record the publish time and version on the campaign record
sop: Record the publish time and page version against the campaign record.
Attach the live check evidence.
Notify the campaign team the pages are live.
Done when the publication is recorded and notified.
verify: Open the campaign record and check the publication entry.
Pass when the record shows publish time and version for every live page.

generic.Defined scope/population: All website content updates published in the period across the customer-facing site.
generic.In-scope period: The publication cycle, with approvals required to be current at the publish date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each publication entry carries URL, content version, approval reference and publish date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Publications recorded reconcile to the content changes deployed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Content register entry holds the approved version and the publish timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Wording differences against the approved version are logged and reverted before publication.
generic.Test population: Every content update published to the live site in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Publication fails where the published wording differs from the compliance-approved version.
generic.Exception handling path: Unapproved wording changes block publication and return to compliance review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication is accepted when disclosures render visibly and the register entry is complete.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository approval linked to the content register in the document repository.

steps.title: Confirm the approval covers the serving jurisdictions
sop: Check the content carries a current compliance approval reference.
Confirm the approval covers the jurisdictions the page serves.
Hold publication where coverage is missing.
Done when the approval coverage is confirmed.
verify: Compare the approval scope to the page's serving jurisdictions.
Pass when the approval covers every jurisdiction the page serves.

steps.title: Diff the content against the approved version
sop: Diff the content to be published against the approved version.
Reject publication on any unapproved wording change.
Record the diff result against the publication entry.
Done when the diff shows no unapproved change.
verify: Re-run the diff on the final publish package.
Pass when no published wording differs from the approved version.

steps.title: Confirm brand elements on the rendered page
sop: Check the logo, colours and typeface on the rendered page.
Check the legal entity and footer disclosures are correct.
Correct any brand element that departs from the guidelines.
Done when the rendered page matches the brand guidelines.
verify: Compare the rendered page against the guideline document.
Pass when no brand element on the page breaches the guidelines.

steps.title: Publish and verify the live rendering
sop: Publish the content to the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Verify the live rendering on desktop and mobile.
Record the publish timestamp.
Done when the content is live and rendering verified.
verify: Load the live URL on both device types.
Pass when the live rendering matches the approved layout on both.

steps.title: Confirm disclosures are visible without extra interaction
sop: Check the disclosures are visible on the page itself.
Reject placements that hide disclosures behind a link or expander.
Correct the placement where needed.
Done when disclosures are visible without extra interaction.
verify: View the page as a first-time visitor.
Pass when every required disclosure is visible without extra interaction.

steps.title: Record the publication in the content register
sop: Record URL, content version, approval reference and publish date.
Attach the diff result and the live check evidence.
File the entry in the document management repository.
Done when the register entry is complete.
verify: Open the register entry and check the four fields.
Pass when every publication entry carries URL, version, approval reference and date.

steps.title: Reconcile publications to content changes deployed
sop: Compare register entries to the content changes deployed in the period.
Investigate any deployment with no register entry.
Record the reconciliation result.
Done when every deployment has a register entry or a logged exception.
verify: Compare the deployment log to the register.
Pass when no content deployment lacks a register entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Campaign landing pages tested for functionality, links and rendering before release.
generic.In-scope period: The QA window between page build completion and publication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: QA record carries tester name, date, browser and device coverage and defect list.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Links tested reconcile to the links present on the page.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: QA sign-off stored with the page version tested and the test evidence.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Defects are logged with severity, fix applied and re-test result.
generic.Test population: Every campaign landing page scheduled for publication.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: QA fails where any open defect remains against a page scheduled for publication.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed pages return to the build team and re-enter QA before scheduling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off requires browser, device, link and form test results recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint QA folder holding the sign-off and test evidence.

steps.title: Test the page on the main browsers and mobile
sop: Open the page on the main browsers and on mobile.
Check layout, images and forms render without breakage.
Capture evidence for each environment.
Done when every required environment has been tested.
verify: Review the captured evidence per environment.
Pass when no required environment shows a broken render.

steps.title: Click every link and call to action
sop: Click every link and call to action on the page.
Confirm each resolves to the intended destination.
Confirm tracking parameters are preserved through redirects.
Done when every link has been clicked and confirmed.
verify: Recount links tested against links on the page.
Pass when every link resolves with its tracking parameters intact.

steps.title: Submit the form with valid and invalid input
sop: Submit the form with valid input and confirm the thank-you state.
Submit with invalid input and confirm the validation messages.
Confirm the CRM record is created on valid submission.
Done when both submission paths behave correctly.
verify: Open the created CRM record from the valid submission.
Pass when the valid submission creates a correctly coded CRM record.

steps.title: Check load performance and consent banner behaviour
sop: Measure the load time against the agreed performance threshold.
Confirm the consent banner behaves correctly before tags fire.
Record both results.
Done when performance and consent behaviour are recorded.
verify: Re-test tag firing with consent declined.
Pass when no tag fires before consent is given.

steps.title: Check disclosures and required legal content
sop: Check the required product disclosures and privacy link are present.
Confirm they render on mobile as well as desktop.
Raise a defect where anything is missing.
Done when the legal content check is recorded.
verify: View the page on mobile as a first-time visitor.
Pass when every required disclosure renders on both device types.

steps.title: Log defects and re-test after the fix
sop: Log each defect with severity and owner.
Re-test after each fix is applied.
Close defects only on a passing re-test.
Done when every defect is closed or accepted with rationale.
verify: Check the defect log for open items.
Pass when no open QA defect remains against a page scheduled for publication.

steps.title: Record the QA sign-off with tester and date
sop: Record the sign-off with tester name, date and page version.
Attach the browser, device, link and form test evidence.
File the record in the QA folder.
Done when the QA sign-off is recorded and filed.
verify: Open the QA record and check the attachments.
Pass when the sign-off records browser, device, link and form results.

generic.Defined scope/population: Priority website pages analysed for behaviour-led improvement recommendations.
generic.In-scope period: The analytics window agreed for the review cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each recommendation carries the change, supporting evidence, expected impact and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recommendations logged reconcile to the pages analysed in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analytics extracts retained with the measurement window and extraction date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recommendations rejected are logged with the reason and the decision maker.
generic.Test population: Every recommendation entered into the improvement backlog.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A recommendation fails where it is carried forward without an accept or reject decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Recommendations without supporting evidence are withdrawn before the backlog entry.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The cycle is accepted when every recommendation is ranked and taken to a decision.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint improvement backlog with the Power BI analytics extracts.

steps.title: Pull analytics for the priority pages
sop: Pull entrances, bounce, scroll depth, click paths, exits and conversion rate.
Record the measurement window and extraction date.
Flag pages with the highest exit and lowest conversion.
Done when the priority pages have a complete analytics extract.
verify: Re-pull one page's figures and compare.
Pass when the re-pulled figures match the recorded extract.

steps.title: Review recordings or heatmaps on the highest-exit pages
sop: Review session recordings or heatmaps for the highest-exit pages.
Identify the specific friction points observed.
Record the observations with references to the sessions.
Done when the friction points are recorded per page.
verify: Check each observation against its session reference.
Pass when every observation cites a session or heatmap reference.

steps.title: Write each recommendation with its evidence
sop: Write each recommendation as a specific change rather than a general theme.
State the evidence behind it and the expected conversion impact.
Withdraw recommendations that lack evidence.
Done when every recommendation has evidence and an expected impact.
verify: Open two recommendations and check the cited evidence.
Pass when no recommendation is entered without supporting evidence.

steps.title: Size the effort with the web team
sop: Size the build effort for each recommendation with the web team.
Record the effort estimate against each item.
Flag items whose effort exceeds the available capacity.
Done when every recommendation carries an effort estimate.
verify: Check each item for an effort estimate.
Pass when no recommendation is ranked without an effort estimate.

steps.title: Rank the list by impact against effort
sop: Rank the recommendations by expected impact against effort.
Record the ranking basis.
Highlight the top items for the next delivery cycle.
Done when every recommendation carries a rank.
verify: Check the ranking against the impact and effort values.
Pass when the ranking follows the recorded impact and effort.

steps.title: Log the recommendations in the improvement backlog
sop: Log each recommendation with owner, evidence and expected impact.
Store the backlog in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
Record the cycle date.
Done when the backlog holds every recommendation with an owner.
verify: Open the backlog and check the entries.
Pass when every backlog entry has evidence, expected impact and an owner.

steps.title: Take each recommendation to an accept or reject decision
sop: Review the backlog with the decision group.
Record accept or reject with the reason for each item.
Schedule accepted items into the delivery plan.
Done when every recommendation has a recorded decision.
verify: Check the backlog for undecided items.
Pass when no recommendation is carried forward without a decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: The web and SEO KPI set reported to the marketing distribution list each period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period with prior-period and prior-year comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI carries current value, target, prior period, prior year and source dataset.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported figures reconcile to the analytics and CRM sources before publication.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report filed with the period reporting pack and the reconciliation record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: KPIs failing reconciliation are held from the report until corrected.
generic.Test population: Every KPI presented in the period report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A KPI fails where it is sourced outside the governed reporting dataset.
generic.Exception handling path: Ungoverned figures are removed and replaced from the governed dataset before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when reconciliation is recorded and variances carry commentary.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI web and SEO report plus the enterprise data warehouse reporting datasets.

steps.title: Refresh the web and SEO KPI set
sop: Refresh sessions, organic sessions, ranking positions, conversion rate, leads and cost per lead.
Confirm each KPI returned a complete period.
Record the refresh timestamp.
Done when every KPI is refreshed for the period.
verify: Check each KPI for missing days.
Pass when no KPI is missing data for the reporting period.

steps.title: Reconcile the figures to the analytics and CRM sources
sop: Compare each reported figure against its analytics or CRM source.
Investigate and resolve differences before publication.
Record the reconciliation with the date.
Done when the reconciliation shows no unexplained difference.
verify: Re-check two reconciled figures against source.
Pass when no reported KPI fails reconciliation to its source.

steps.title: Compare each KPI against target and prior periods
sop: Compare each KPI against target, prior period and prior year.
Highlight variances beyond the reporting threshold.
Record the variance figures.
Done when every KPI carries its three comparisons.
verify: Check the comparison values against the source history.
Pass when every KPI shows target, prior-period and prior-year values.

steps.title: Write commentary linking movements to actions
sop: Link each highlighted movement to content published, technical fixes, campaign activity or algorithm change.
State where the cause is unknown rather than inferring one.
Record the commentary against each variance.
Done when every highlighted variance has commentary.
verify: Cross-check variances against commentary entries.
Pass when no highlighted variance is left without commentary.

steps.title: Confirm every KPI comes from a governed dataset
sop: List each KPI with its source dataset reference.
Remove or replace figures sourced outside the governed datasets.
Record the source list with the report.
Done when every KPI has a governed source recorded.
verify: Trace two KPIs back to their governed dataset.
Pass when no reported KPI is sourced outside the governed dataset.

steps.title: Issue the report on the scheduled date
sop: Issue the report to the distribution list on the scheduled date.
Attach the reconciliation record and the source list.
Record the issue date.
Done when the report is issued on schedule.
verify: Check the issue date against the reporting calendar.
Pass when the report was issued on its scheduled date.

steps.title: File the report with the period reporting pack
sop: File the report with the period reporting pack.
Confirm the filed version matches the issued version.
Record the filing location.
Done when the report is filed with the pack.
verify: Open the filed report and compare to the issued version.
Pass when the filed report shows traffic, ranking and conversion against target and prior period.

generic.Defined scope/population: All errors surfaced by the technical SEO crawl for the site in the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The remediation cycle from crawl publication to re-crawl verification.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each issue row carries URL, error type, severity, fix applied and re-crawl date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Errors triaged reconcile to the errors listed on the crawl issue report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issue log stored with the re-crawl verification date per URL.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recurring errors are logged and escalated for root-cause investigation.
generic.Test population: Every URL carrying a logged crawl error in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Remediation fails where a previously logged server error or broken link returns on re-crawl.
generic.Exception handling path: Errors that cannot be fixed in the cycle are logged with an owner and a target date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The cycle is accepted when each error shows a fix and a re-crawl verification.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint SEO issue log with the crawl exports attached.

steps.title: Triage the crawl error list by severity
sop: Rank server errors and broken conversion paths first.
Rank redirect chains next, then metadata issues.
Record the severity against each error.
Done when every error carries a severity rank.
verify: Check the severity assignment against the triage rules.
Pass when every error carries a severity consistent with the rules.

steps.title: Fix broken and redirecting URLs
sop: Point each broken or redirecting URL to the correct live destination.
Avoid pointing corrections at the home page.
Record the destination applied per URL.
Done when every broken URL has a corrected destination.
verify: Load a sample of corrected URLs.
Pass when every corrected URL resolves to a relevant live destination.

steps.title: Correct the indexation errors
sop: Remove unintended noindex tags on priority pages.
Resolve canonical conflicts and robots directives blocking priority pages.
Record the correction per URL.
Done when every indexation error is corrected.
verify: Read the live directives on the corrected pages.
Pass when no priority page remains blocked from indexing.

steps.title: Resolve duplicate titles and meta descriptions
sop: Identify pages sharing a title or meta description.
Rewrite the duplicates to unique values.
Record the new values per URL.
Done when no affected page shares a title or description.
verify: Re-run the duplicate check on the affected set.
Pass when the duplicate check returns no affected page.

steps.title: Re-crawl the affected URLs
sop: Re-crawl the URLs where a fix was applied.
Confirm each error clears on the re-crawl.
Record the re-crawl verification date.
Done when every fixed URL has been re-crawled.
verify: Compare the re-crawl result to the original error list.
Pass when no previously logged server error or broken link returns.

steps.title: Escalate recurring errors for root-cause work
sop: Identify errors recurring across cycles.
Escalate them for root-cause investigation with the web team.
Record the escalation and the owner.
Done when every recurring error is escalated with an owner.
verify: Compare recurring errors between cycles.
Pass when every recurring error carries an escalation record.

steps.title: Publish the issue log with verification dates
sop: Publish the issue log showing error, fix and re-crawl verification date.
Note errors carried forward with owners and target dates.
File the log in the SEO folder.
Done when the issue log is published for the cycle.
verify: Open the issue log and check the verification column.
Pass when every error row shows the fix applied and a re-crawl verification date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Conversion-rate optimisation experiments run on high-traffic landing pages.
generic.In-scope period: Each experiment's run from launch to the pre-set sample size or duration.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each experiment carries hypothesis, variable, success metric, sample size and confidence level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Traffic split between variants reconciles to the planned allocation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Experiment register entry stores the result, confidence and implementation decision.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Experiments stopped early are logged with the reason and marked inconclusive.
generic.Test population: Visitors assigned to the test variants on the experiment page.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: An experiment fails where a live variant omits a required disclosure or uses a pressure pattern.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-compliant variants are removed from the test immediately and the run is restarted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Results are accepted only at the pre-set sample size with the confidence level recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Experiment register in the BI/reporting platform linked to the portal page versions.

steps.title: Write the hypothesis and the test design
sop: Write the hypothesis and name the single element under test.
State the success metric and the minimum sample size.
Register the design before the variants are built.
Done when the design is registered ahead of the build.
verify: Check the registration timestamp against the build date.
Pass when the design was registered before the variants were built.

steps.title: Check both variants for disclosures and design patterns
sop: Confirm both variants carry the required disclosures and calls to action.
Reject any variant using a misleading or pressure-selling design pattern.
Record the compliance check per variant.
Done when both variants pass the compliance check.
verify: Review each variant as a consumer would.
Pass when no live variant omits a required disclosure or uses a pressure pattern.

steps.title: Split traffic randomly with sticky assignment
sop: Split traffic randomly between the variants.
Confirm the assignment is sticky per visitor.
Confirm the tracking distinguishes the variants.
Done when the split is live with sticky assignment confirmed.
verify: Re-visit as a test user and check the variant served.
Pass when the same visitor is consistently served the same variant.

steps.title: Run to the pre-set sample size or duration
sop: Run the test to the pre-set sample size or duration.
Do not stop early on an early lead.
Record interim readings as observation only.
Done when the pre-set sample size or duration is reached.
verify: Compare the stop point to the registered sample size.
Pass when the test ran to its registered sample size or duration.

steps.title: Record the result with statistical confidence
sop: Calculate the result and the statistical confidence.
Mark tests failing to reach significance as inconclusive.
Record the figures in the experiment register.
Done when the result and confidence are recorded.
verify: Recompute the confidence from the recorded data.
Pass when the recomputed confidence matches the register entry.

steps.title: Implement the winner or revert the page
sop: Implement the winning variant on the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Revert the page where the test was inconclusive or negative.
Record the implementation decision and date.
Done when the page reflects the recorded decision.
verify: Load the live page and check which variant is served.
Pass when the live page matches the recorded implementation decision.

steps.title: Log the outcome in the experiment register
sop: Log the hypothesis, sample size, result, confidence and decision.
Link the page versions used.
File the entry for the next planning cycle.
Done when the register entry is complete.
verify: Open the register entry and check the fields.
Pass when the entry records hypothesis, sample size, result and confidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full published site crawled to the documented crawl configuration for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The current crawl cycle compared against the prior crawl.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The crawl record carries start URLs, depth, subdomains, render mode and exclusions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Crawled page count reconciles to the sitemap count within the agreed tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Crawl export retained with the configuration used and the crawl date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded site sections are logged with the documented exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: Every page returned by the crawl for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The crawl fails where a published section is excluded without a documented reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Crawls returning far fewer pages than the sitemap are re-run with corrected configuration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The crawl is accepted when the issue list is severity ranked with owners assigned.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint SEO folder holding the crawl export and issue list.

steps.title: Confirm the crawl configuration against the standard
sop: Check start URLs, depth, subdomains, render mode and exclusions.
Compare the configuration against the documented standard.
Record any deviation and the reason.
Done when the configuration matches the standard or deviations are recorded.
verify: Compare the saved configuration to the standard.
Pass when no undocumented deviation remains in the configuration.

steps.title: Run the crawl across the full published site
sop: Run the crawl across the published site.
Record the crawled page count and the crawl date.
Re-run where the crawl terminates early.
Done when the crawl completes across the published site.
verify: Compare the crawled page count to the sitemap count.
Pass when the crawled count is in line with the sitemap count.

steps.title: Extract the issue set from the crawl
sop: Extract broken links, server errors, redirect chains and orphan pages.
Extract missing or duplicate titles and metadata and slow pages.
Record the counts by issue type.
Done when every issue type has a recorded count.
verify: Spot-check two extracted issues on the live site.
Pass when the extracted issues reproduce on direct check.

steps.title: Compare against the prior crawl
sop: Compare the issue set against the prior crawl.
Separate new issues from carried-forward ones.
Record the split by issue type.
Done when new and carried-forward issues are separated.
verify: Check a carried-forward issue against the prior crawl export.
Pass when the carried-forward set matches the prior crawl.

steps.title: Rank the issues by severity
sop: Rank server errors and broken conversion paths highest.
Rank the remaining issues by traffic and indexation impact.
Record the ranking basis.
Done when every issue carries a severity ranking.
verify: Check the ranking against the severity rules.
Pass when every issue carries a severity consistent with the rules.

steps.title: Assign each issue to a remediation owner
sop: Assign a remediation owner and target date to each ranked issue.
Escalate issues requiring engineering capacity.
Record the assignments in the issue list.
Done when every issue has an owner and a target date.
verify: Check every issue row for an owner.
Pass when no issue is published without a remediation owner.

steps.title: Publish the issue list and document exclusions
sop: Publish the issue list with severity ranking and owners.
Document any published section excluded from the crawl with its reason.
File the crawl export with the list.
Done when the list and exclusion reasons are published.
verify: Compare the crawl scope to the published site sections.
Pass when no published section is excluded without a documented reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every post published from the corporate social accounts and its associated engagement thread.
generic.In-scope period: The archiving period covering all posts published since the last archive run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archive entry carries final text, creative, publish timestamp, platform and account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived post count reconciles to the published post count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Original and final states of edited posts retained with the change timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Posts that cannot be captured are logged with the platform limitation and the workaround.
generic.Test population: All posts published in the reporting period across monitored accounts.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Archiving fails where a published post is missing from the archive for the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing posts are recaptured from platform exports before the run is signed off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The run is accepted when a retrieval sample renders within the service standard.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt social archive linked from the compliance evidence repository.

steps.title: Capture each published post with its metadata
sop: Capture the final text, creative, publish timestamp, platform and posting account.
Include paid and organic posts from the monitored accounts.
Record the capture run date.
Done when every published post in the period is captured.
verify: Compare captured posts to the platform publishing log.
Pass when no published post is missing from the capture.

steps.title: Capture the associated engagement record
sop: Capture comments, replies and any company responses on each post.
Treat the engagement thread as part of the communication record.
Attach the thread to the post archive entry.
Done when every archived post carries its engagement thread.
verify: Open two archive entries and check the threads.
Pass when every archived post has its engagement thread attached.

steps.title: Archive edited and deleted posts in both states
sop: Identify posts edited or deleted during the period.
Archive the original and the final state with the change timestamp.
Record the reason for the edit or deletion.
Done when every edited or deleted post is archived in both states.
verify: Open an edited post entry and check both states.
Pass when every edited post shows original and final states with timestamps.

steps.title: Apply the advertising records retention period
sop: Apply the advertising records retention period to each archive entry.
Record the destruction-eligible date.
Confirm nothing is deleted before that date.
Done when every entry carries a destruction-eligible date.
verify: Sample archive entries for retention dates.
Pass when no archive entry lacks a destruction-eligible date.

steps.title: Verify retrieval from the archive
sop: Draw a sample of archived posts and retrieve them.
Confirm each renders correctly within the retrieval service standard.
Record the retrieval test result.
Done when the retrieval sample renders correctly.
verify: Time the retrieval for the sampled entries.
Pass when every sampled entry renders inside the retrieval standard.

steps.title: Reconcile archived posts to published posts
sop: Count published posts for the period from the platform logs.
Compare against the count archived.
Recapture any missing post before sign-off.
Done when the two counts reconcile.
verify: Recompute both counts for the period.
Pass when no published post is missing from the archive for the period.

steps.title: Sign off the archive run
sop: Review the reconciliation, exceptions and retrieval test.
Record the sign-off with name and date.
File the run record in the compliance evidence repository.
Done when the archive run is signed off and filed.
verify: Open the run record and check the sign-off.
Pass when the run record carries a sign-off name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Social content supporting PR and event announcements for product launches and news.
generic.In-scope period: From announcement planning until the post-announcement follow-up window closes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The joint schedule carries announcement date, embargo time, approved messaging and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled social posts reconcile to the announcement plan items agreed with PR.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Joint schedule filed with the approved messaging version and the embargo time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Posts requested outside the plan are logged and approved or declined before scheduling.
generic.Test population: Every social post tied to the announcement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The plan fails where a social post is scheduled before the embargo or release time.
generic.Exception handling path: Posts scheduled ahead of the embargo are rescheduled and the schedule is re-checked.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The plan is accepted when a single named owner holds day-of publishing.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint announcement folder holding the joint schedule.

steps.title: Confirm the announcement date and embargo with PR
sop: Confirm the announcement date, embargo time and approved messaging with the PR and events owner.
Record the confirmation before anything is scheduled.
Note the approval version of the messaging.
Done when date, embargo and messaging are confirmed in writing.
verify: Check the confirmation record against the PR plan.
Pass when nothing is scheduled before the confirmation is recorded.

steps.title: Build the social plan around the announcement
sop: Plan the pre-event teaser, live posts and follow-up.
Map each post to the approved message.
Record the intended publish time for each.
Done when every planned post maps to an approved message.
verify: Compare each post to the approved messaging.
Pass when no planned post departs from the approved messaging.

steps.title: Check no post precedes the release time
sop: Compare each scheduled time against the press release and regulatory announcement time.
Reschedule any post falling before the release.
Record the check result.
Done when every post is scheduled at or after the release time.
verify: Re-read the schedule against the release time.
Pass when no social post is scheduled before the approved embargo or release time.

steps.title: Align assets and hashtags with event branding
sop: Align the creative and hashtags with the event branding.
Confirm any partner or venue mark is cleared for use.
Replace assets that use uncleared marks.
Done when every asset uses cleared marks and aligned branding.
verify: Check the mark clearances against the agreements.
Pass when no post uses a partner or venue mark without clearance.

steps.title: Circulate the joint schedule to PR, events and social
sop: Circulate the combined schedule through Microsoft Teams / Email.
Confirm each team accepts its part of the schedule.
File the schedule in the announcement folder.
Done when all three teams have accepted the schedule.
verify: Check the acceptance responses against the distribution list.
Pass when every team has accepted its part of the schedule.

steps.title: Name a single owner for day-of publishing
sop: Name one owner responsible for publishing on the day.
Name a named deputy for cover.
Record both on the schedule.
Done when the schedule names a single day-of owner and a deputy.
verify: Check the schedule for the named owner.
Pass when the schedule carries a single named owner per announcement.

steps.title: Confirm publication against the schedule after the announcement
sop: Check each planned post published at its scheduled time.
Record variances and the reason.
File the completed schedule with the announcement record.
Done when publication is confirmed against the schedule.
verify: Compare published times to scheduled times.
Pass when every variance from the schedule is recorded with a reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: All organic social posts planned for the coming period across the approved platforms.
generic.In-scope period: The coming publishing period with the current period locked against additions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each post carries platform, theme, format, audience, owner and publish date and time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Planned posts by content type reconcile to the agreed brand, educational and product mix.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published calendar filed with version and publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late additions to the locked period are logged with the approval reference.
generic.Test population: Every post on the published organic social calendar.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A calendared post carrying a product claim fails without a scheduled compliance review.
generic.Exception handling path: Posts without a review window are moved out until a review slot is available.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The calendar is accepted when every post carries platform, owner and publish date.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint social calendar folder holding the published version.

steps.title: Map the organic calendar against campaign and event dates
sop: Overlay the campaign calendar, product launches and event dates.
Position organic content to support rather than duplicate paid activity.
Record the anchors used.
Done when the organic plan is mapped against the anchors.
verify: Compare the organic plan to the campaign calendar.
Pass when no organic post duplicates a paid message in the same window.

steps.title: Slot posts by platform, theme and format
sop: Slot each post by platform, theme, format and target audience.
Set the intended publish date and time.
Assign an owner to each post.
Done when every post has a platform, date, time and owner.
verify: Check each post row for the required fields.
Pass when no post is missing platform, owner or publish date.

steps.title: Set creative and compliance review windows
sop: Set the working-back date for creative production.
Set a compliance review window for any post carrying a product claim.
Flag posts whose lead time is too short.
Done when every claim-carrying post has a review window.
verify: Check review windows against publish dates.
Pass when no calendared post carrying a product claim lacks a compliance review.

steps.title: Balance the content mix against the agreed ratio
sop: Count posts by brand, educational, product and community content.
Compare against the agreed ratio.
Rebalance the calendar where the mix is off.
Done when the mix matches the agreed ratio.
verify: Recount the mix after rebalancing.
Pass when the content mix matches the agreed ratio within tolerance.

steps.title: Publish the calendar to the marketing channel
sop: Publish the calendar to Microsoft 365 / SharePoint with a version.
Announce it to the marketing channel.
Record the publication date.
Done when the calendar is published and announced.
verify: Open the published calendar and check the post count.
Pass when the published calendar shows platform, owner and publish date on every post.

steps.title: Lock the current period against unapproved additions
sop: Lock the current period on the published calendar.
Require the marketing manager's approval for additions.
Log approved additions with the reason.
Done when the current period is locked.
verify: Check additions in the locked period for approvals.
Pass when no post was added to the locked period without approval.

steps.title: Load the schedule into the marketing automation platform
sop: Load the approved calendar into the scheduling platform.
Confirm the loaded schedule matches the published calendar.
Record the load date.
Done when the platform schedule matches the calendar.
verify: Compare the platform schedule to the published calendar.
Pass when no scheduled post differs from the published calendar.

generic.Defined scope/population: All paid social placements running against the approved budget in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The current pacing period measured against the approved placement budgets.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each placement carries spend, budget, CPA, conversions and its approved creative reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Platform spend by placement reconciles to the approved budget tracked in reporting.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pacing and optimisation actions logged with date and placement.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Placements over CPA target are logged with the reallocation or pause decision.
generic.Test population: Every live paid social ad, audience and placement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A placement fails where a custom audience was built from data lacking a marketing consent basis.
generic.Exception handling path: Audiences without a consent basis are removed and the placement is paused.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The period is accepted when spend, CPA and conversion are reported against budget.
generic.Evidence location: BI/reporting platform paid social report plus the CRM conversion attribution records.

steps.title: Check spend and pacing per placement
sop: Check daily and cumulative spend against the approved budget per placement.
Adjust pacing to avoid over- or under-delivery.
Record the adjustment made.
Done when every placement is pacing within tolerance.
verify: Recompute pacing after adjustment.
Pass when no placement is pacing outside the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Confirm every live creative carries an approval reference
sop: Check each live ad creative and copy variant against the approved register.
Pause variants with no approval reference.
Record the reference against each live variant.
Done when every live variant carries an approval reference.
verify: Sample live variants against the approval register.
Pass when no live variant runs without a compliance approval reference.

steps.title: Review audience targeting and consent basis
sop: Review targeting for prohibited or sensitive attributes.
Confirm custom audiences were built from permitted data with a valid consent basis.
Remove audiences failing the check.
Done when every live audience passes the targeting and consent review.
verify: Trace one custom audience back to its source data and consent.
Pass when no custom audience lacks a valid marketing consent basis.

steps.title: Confirm advertising labelling and landing page compliance
sop: Confirm each paid post is labelled as advertising per the platform requirement.
Open the landing page and confirm it is compliant and matches the ad.
Pause placements failing either check.
Done when labelling and landing pages are confirmed for every placement.
verify: View two live placements as a consumer.
Pass when every paid post is labelled as advertising and links to a compliant page.

steps.title: Review CPA and conversion by placement
sop: Review CPA and conversion rate per placement from the CRM attribution.
Reallocate budget away from placements above target.
Record the reallocation.
Done when every above-target placement has an action.
verify: Check CPA figures against the target.
Pass when every above-target placement has a recorded action.

steps.title: Log the pacing and optimisation actions
sop: Log every budget, bid, pause and creative action with its date.
Attach before and after figures.
File the log against the paid social record.
Done when the period's actions are logged.
verify: Open the log and check the entries.
Pass when every action taken in the period is logged with its figures.

steps.title: Report paid social performance to the marketing manager
sop: Report spend, CPA and conversion by placement against budget.
Agree the actions for the next period.
File the report with the period pack.
Done when the report is issued and actions agreed.
verify: Check the reported figures against the reporting platform.
Pass when the report shows spend, CPA and conversion by placement against budget.

generic.Defined scope/population: Organic social posts scheduled and published to the approved corporate accounts.
generic.In-scope period: The publishing window covered by the current social calendar period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scheduled post carries approval reference, platform, account and publish time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posts published reconcile to the posts scheduled on the calendar for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published record pushed to the social archive with the publish timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Posts pulled before publication are logged with the reason and the rescheduled date.
generic.Test population: Every post scheduled for publication in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Publication fails where a post is published from an account outside the approved list.
generic.Exception handling path: Posts with expired approvals are held and returned for re-approval before scheduling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication is accepted when the post goes live as scheduled and reaches the archive.
generic.Evidence location: Marketing automation platform publishing log and the document repository social archive.

steps.title: Confirm the approval reference and expiry before scheduling
sop: Check each post carries a compliance approval reference.
Check the approval has not expired against the publish date.
Hold posts failing either check.
Done when every scheduled post carries a live approval.
verify: Compare approval expiry to the publish date.
Pass when no post is scheduled on an expired approval.

steps.title: Check the rendered post on each platform
sop: Check character limits, image crop, link preview and hashtag rendering per platform.
Correct any element that breaks in the platform preview.
Record the render check.
Done when the post renders correctly on every target platform.
verify: Open the preview on each target platform.
Pass when no platform preview shows a broken render.

steps.title: Confirm disclosures sit in the post itself
sop: Check posts making a product claim carry the required disclosure in the post.
Reject reliance on a linked page for a required disclosure.
Correct the post or remove the claim.
Done when every claim-carrying post holds its disclosure inline.
verify: Read the rendered post without following the link.
Pass when every required disclosure is readable in the post itself.

steps.title: Schedule to approved corporate accounts only
sop: Schedule the post to the approved corporate accounts.
Confirm the publish time matches the calendar entry.
Reject scheduling to any unapproved account.
Done when every post is scheduled to an approved account at the calendared time.
verify: Check the scheduled account list against the approved list.
Pass when no post is scheduled from an account outside the approved list.

steps.title: Verify the post went live as scheduled
sop: Check each post published at its scheduled time.
Investigate and reschedule failed publications.
Record the actual publish time.
Done when every scheduled post is live or rescheduled.
verify: Compare actual publish times to scheduled times.
Pass when every scheduled post is live or has a recorded reschedule.

steps.title: Push the published record into the social archive
sop: Push the published post and its metadata into the archive.
Confirm the archive entry is created.
Record the archive reference on the calendar entry.
Done when every published post has an archive entry.
verify: Open the archive entry from the calendar reference.
Pass when every published post has a retrievable archive entry.

steps.title: Reconcile published posts to the calendar
sop: Compare posts published to the calendar entries for the period.
Log posts pulled with the reason and rescheduled date.
Record the reconciliation.
Done when the counts reconcile with exceptions logged.
verify: Recompute the two counts for the period.
Pass when published posts plus logged exceptions equal the calendared posts.

generic.Defined scope/population: Organic and paid social performance across every managed platform for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period compared against target, prior period and the platform benchmark.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric row carries platform, organic or paid split, value, target and prior period.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attributed conversions reconcile to the CRM social attribution records.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report filed with the extraction date and the attribution rule applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics affected by platform definition changes are noted with the comparability impact.
generic.Test population: Every metric presented in the social performance report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The report fails where a conversion figure is presented without a stated attribution rule.
generic.Exception handling path: Unattributable conversions are excluded and the exclusion is stated in the report.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when organic and paid are split and variances carry commentary.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI social performance report plus the CRM attribution records.

steps.title: Pull reach and engagement by platform
sop: Pull reach, impressions, engagement rate, follower growth and click-through per platform.
Split the figures into organic and paid.
Record the extraction date.
Done when every platform has an organic and paid split.
verify: Check the split totals against the platform totals.
Pass when the organic and paid figures sum to the platform totals.

steps.title: Pull attributed conversions from the CRM
sop: Pull the downstream conversions attributed to social.
Confirm the attribution rule applied.
Record the rule alongside the figures.
Done when conversions are pulled with the attribution rule recorded.
verify: Trace two conversions back through the attribution rule.
Pass when no conversion figure is reported without a stated attribution rule.

steps.title: Compare metrics against target, prior period and benchmark
sop: Compare each metric against target, prior period and the platform benchmark.
Flag the variances beyond threshold.
Record the comparison values.
Done when every metric carries its three comparisons.
verify: Check the comparison values against the source history.
Pass when every metric shows target, prior-period and benchmark comparisons.

steps.title: Identify the top and bottom performing posts
sop: Identify the top and bottom performing posts for the period.
State the specific content characteristic behind each.
Record the examples with their figures.
Done when top and bottom posts are identified with reasons.
verify: Check the stated characteristic against the post content.
Pass when each cited post has a stated content characteristic.

steps.title: Note platform metric definition changes
sop: Note any platform metric definition change in the period.
State the comparability impact on the trend.
Annotate the affected metrics in the report.
Done when every definition change is noted.
verify: Check the annotations against the platform change notices.
Pass when every definition change affecting a metric is annotated.

steps.title: Issue the report to the distribution list
sop: Issue the report to the distribution list on the scheduled date.
Attach the attribution rule and extraction dates.
File the report with the period pack.
Done when the report is issued and filed.
verify: Open the filed report and check the attachments.
Pass when the report splits organic and paid reach, engagement and conversions.

steps.title: Record the agreed actions for the next period
sop: Review the report with the social team.
Agree the content and budget actions for the next period.
Record the actions with owners and dates.
Done when every agreed action has an owner and a date.
verify: Check the action record for owners.
Pass when no agreed action is recorded without an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound social mentions, comments and direct messages on the monitored accounts.
generic.In-scope period: The daily response window measured against the published response-time standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each interaction carries triage category, responder, response timestamp and outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Interactions received reconcile to interactions triaged and closed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response threads retained with timestamps for the communication record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Escalated items are logged with the escalation route and the outcome.
generic.Test population: Every inbound social interaction received in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A response fails where personal, policy or claim detail is exchanged in a public thread.
generic.Exception handling path: Threads containing sensitive detail are moved to a secure channel before any response.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The period is accepted when every interaction is logged with a triage and a response time.
generic.Evidence location: Marketing automation platform social inbox log plus the CRM complaint and case records.

steps.title: Work the inbound queue and triage each item
sop: Work the queue of mentions, comments and direct messages.
Triage each as enquiry, complaint, claim matter or spam.
Record the triage category and time received.
Done when every inbound item carries a triage category.
verify: Check the queue for untriaged items.
Pass when every inbound interaction is logged with a triage category.

steps.title: Respond to general enquiries using approved wording
sop: Respond within the published response standard.
Use approved response wording and never improvise product terms.
Record the response timestamp.
Done when every enquiry has a response within the standard.
verify: Compare response times to the published standard.
Pass when every enquiry response used approved wording.

steps.title: Move sensitive threads to a secure channel
sop: Identify threads containing personal, policy, claim or medical detail.
Move the conversation to a secure channel before responding.
Record the channel move.
Done when every sensitive thread has been moved before response.
verify: Review public threads for sensitive detail.
Pass when no personal, policy or claim detail is exchanged publicly.

steps.title: Log dissatisfaction as a complaint in the CRM
sop: Log any expression of dissatisfaction as a complaint within 24 hours.
Hand the complaint to the complaints team.
Record the complaint reference against the interaction.
Done when every complaint is logged and handed over.
verify: Compare complaint logs to the flagged interactions.
Pass when no expression of dissatisfaction is left unlogged past 24 hours.

steps.title: Escalate regulatory and reputational items same day
sop: Escalate regulatory threats, media enquiries and reputational risk items.
Notify the marketing manager and compliance the same day.
Record the escalation and the response.
Done when every escalation item is raised the same day.
verify: Compare escalation timestamps to receipt timestamps.
Pass when every escalation item was raised on the day received.

steps.title: Close each interaction with an outcome
sop: Record the outcome for each interaction.
Close items requiring no further action.
Carry open items into the next day's queue.
Done when every interaction is closed or carried forward.
verify: Check the queue for items with no outcome.
Pass when every interaction carries an outcome or a carry-forward.

steps.title: Report response performance against the standard
sop: Report volumes, triage split and response times against the standard.
Flag categories consistently missing the standard.
File the report against the social record.
Done when the response performance report is issued.
verify: Check the reported response times against the log.
Pass when the reported times reconcile to the interaction log.

generic.Defined scope/population: Corporate pages and the monitored producer accounts screened for the review period.
generic.In-scope period: The screening period with findings tracked to their remediation deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each finding carries account, post reference, breach type, evidence and remediation status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accounts reviewed reconcile to the monitored account list for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated screenshots of offending posts retained before removal is requested.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producers who do not remediate are logged and escalated to their supervisor.
generic.Test population: All posts on the monitored accounts within the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Screening fails where an open finding sits past its remediation deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Unremediated findings escalate to distribution management for enforcement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The period is accepted when the screening record lists accounts, findings and status.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository screening record with the dated evidence captures.

steps.title: Run the monitoring sweep across the accounts
sop: Sweep the corporate pages and the monitored producer accounts for the period.
Record the accounts reviewed and the review dates.
Flag accounts that could not be accessed.
Done when every monitored account has been swept.
verify: Compare accounts reviewed to the monitored account list.
Pass when no monitored account is missing from the sweep.

steps.title: Screen posts for prohibited content
sop: Screen for unapproved product claims, guarantees and misleading comparisons.
Screen for unlicensed product promotion and misuse of the carrier brand.
Record each finding with the post reference.
Done when every screened post has a recorded outcome.
verify: Re-read two findings against the prohibited content list.
Pass when every finding maps to a prohibited content category.

steps.title: Check producer identification on their posts
sop: Check producer posts identify the producer and agency correctly.
Check the posts do not imply the producer is the carrier.
Record the identification finding.
Done when producer identification is checked on every reviewed post.
verify: Read a sample of producer posts as a consumer.
Pass when no producer post implies the producer is the carrier.

steps.title: Capture dated evidence before requesting removal
sop: Capture a dated screenshot of each offending post.
Store the capture in the compliance evidence repository.
Only then request removal or correction.
Done when every offending post has dated evidence stored.
verify: Open the stored capture and check the date stamp.
Pass when every finding has dated evidence stored before removal.

steps.title: Notify the producer and their supervisor
sop: Notify the producer and supervisor with the required correction.
State the remediation deadline.
Record the notification date.
Done when every finding has been notified with a deadline.
verify: Compare notifications to findings raised.
Pass when every finding has a recorded notification and deadline.

steps.title: Track findings to removal or amendment
sop: Track each finding to confirmed removal or amendment.
Re-check the account to confirm the change.
Escalate findings past their deadline.
Done when every finding is confirmed remediated or escalated.
verify: Re-check the offending posts after the deadline.
Pass when no open social compliance finding sits past its remediation deadline.

steps.title: File the screening record for the period
sop: Record accounts reviewed, findings and remediation status.
Attach the evidence captures and notifications.
File the record in the compliance evidence repository.
Done when the screening record is complete and filed.
verify: Open the filed record and check the fields.
Pass when the record lists accounts reviewed, findings and remediation status.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every tracked social account and the KPI series maintained for it.
generic.In-scope period: The current tracking period with a complete run of daily platform data.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI row carries platform, account, date, metric value and refresh timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Date rows per account reconcile to the days in the tracking period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: KPI series published with the refresh timestamp and the definition version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing days and duplicate rows are logged with the correction applied.
generic.Test population: The full KPI series for every tracked account in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The series fails where a date row is missing or duplicated for a tracked account.
generic.Exception handling path: Platform feeds returning incomplete data are re-pulled before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The series is accepted when data is complete and definition changes are annotated.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse social KPI tables surfaced in the Power BI dashboard.

steps.title: Refresh the platform data feeds
sop: Refresh the feed for every tracked platform and account.
Confirm each returned a complete period of data.
Re-pull feeds returning partial data.
Done when every account has a complete period loaded.
verify: Count date rows per account against the period length.
Pass when every tracked account has a complete period of data.

steps.title: Recalculate the tracked KPIs
sop: Recalculate reach, engagement rate, follower growth and brand-mention sentiment.
Calculate by platform and in total.
Record the calculation timestamp.
Done when every KPI is recalculated for the period.
verify: Recompute one KPI independently.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the published series.

steps.title: Run the data quality checks
sop: Check for missing days, duplicate rows and sudden step changes.
Investigate step changes for platform definition changes.
Record the check results.
Done when every quality check has a recorded result.
verify: Review the quality check output.
Pass when no missing or duplicated date row remains in the series.

steps.title: Flag KPIs breaching their alert thresholds
sop: Compare each KPI against its alert threshold.
Flag breaches, particularly negative sentiment spikes.
Attach the underlying cut to each flag.
Done when every breach is flagged with its underlying cut.
verify: Recheck the flags against the threshold definitions.
Pass when every threshold breach is flagged.

steps.title: Raise sentiment spikes to the marketing manager same day
sop: Raise negative sentiment spikes to the marketing manager the same day.
Provide the driving posts or mentions.
Record the escalation and the response.
Done when every sentiment spike is raised the same day.
verify: Compare escalation timestamps to the flag timestamps.
Pass when every sentiment spike was raised on the day detected.

steps.title: Publish the refreshed KPI series
sop: Publish the refreshed series to the Power BI dashboard.
Confirm the dashboard shows the current period.
Record the publication timestamp.
Done when the dashboard reflects the current period.
verify: Open the dashboard and check the period shown.
Pass when the published period matches the loaded data period.

steps.title: Annotate definition changes breaking comparability
sop: Record platform metric definition changes affecting the period.
Annotate the affected series so trend readers see the break.
Include the note in the KPI documentation.
Done when every definition change is annotated.
verify: Open an affected series and check the annotation.
Pass when no comparability break is published without an annotation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every lead captured at the event across badge scan, digital form and paper card.
generic.In-scope period: The event days plus the agreed upload window after the event closes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each lead carries name, company, contact details, product interest, consent flag and capturing staff.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Leads uploaded to the CRM reconcile to the capture device totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consent basis stored with the exact wording version shown at capture.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Leads with incomplete mandatory fields are logged and completed or discarded.
generic.Test population: All leads captured at the event and loaded into the CRM.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A lead fails where it is marked for marketing contact without recorded consent evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Leads without consent evidence are loaded without marketing permission set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Capture is accepted when counts reconcile and every lead carries the event campaign code.
generic.Evidence location: CRM event lead records plus the Microsoft 365 / SharePoint event folder capture logs.

steps.title: Confirm the capture method and consent wording on stand
sop: Confirm which capture method is in use for the event.
Confirm the consent wording is displayed at the point of collection.
Correct any device or form missing the wording.
Done when every capture point displays the consent wording.
verify: Inspect each capture point before doors open.
Pass when no capture point collects data without displaying the consent wording.

steps.title: Capture the mandatory fields for each lead
sop: Capture name, company, contact details and product interest.
Capture the consent flag and the capturing staff member.
Prompt for missing fields at the point of capture.
Done when every lead has the mandatory fields captured.
verify: Check the capture export for blank mandatory fields.
Pass when no captured lead is missing a mandatory field.

steps.title: Record the consent basis and wording version
sop: Record the consent basis for each lead.
Record the exact wording version shown at capture.
Flag leads where no consent was given.
Done when every lead carries a consent basis or a no-consent flag.
verify: Open a consented lead and check the wording version.
Pass when no lead marked for marketing contact lacks consent evidence.

steps.title: Secure the captured data during the event
