State the variance and its driver.
Record the comparison on the event record.
Done when the comparison against approval objectives is recorded.
verify: Check the approval objectives against the comparison.
Pass when the comparison uses the objectives recorded at approval.

steps.title: Record the ROI result against the event record
sop: Record full cost, attributed pipeline and the ROI measures.
Attach the extract and the attribution rule used.
File against the event record.
Done when the ROI record is complete and filed.
verify: Open the ROI record and check the fields.
Pass when the record shows full cost, attributed pipeline and the approval comparison.

steps.title: Feed the result into the annual planning cycle
sop: Tag the result for retrieval in the next annual planning cycle.
Summarise the implication for renewal or exit.
Confirm the planning owner has the result.
Done when the result is tagged and handed to planning.
verify: Search the planning tag for the ROI result.
Pass when the result is retrievable from the planning tag.

generic.Defined scope/population: The rights, fee, deliverables and measurement commitments negotiated for the sponsorship.
generic.In-scope period: The negotiation window before any payment is committed or contract executed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The agreement records rights, fee, duration, exclusivity, measurement and brand-protection terms.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The negotiated fee reconciles to the budget approved for the item on the annual plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed agreement filed with signature date and the due diligence record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms the organiser refuses are logged with the risk accepted or the walk-away decision.
generic.Test population: Every clause in the executed sponsorship agreement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The deal fails where payment is committed ahead of execution and completed due diligence.
generic.Exception handling path: Agreements without brand-protection terms are escalated before signature.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Execution requires documented fair value and the measurement commitments in writing.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository sponsorship contract folder with the due diligence record.

steps.title: Specify the rights being bought
sop: Specify branding placements, speaking slots, delegate passes and data rights.
Specify category exclusivity and the duration.
Record the rights schedule in the draft agreement.
Done when every right sought is written into the draft.
verify: Compare the draft schedule to the rights sought.
Pass when no sought right is missing from the draft schedule.

steps.title: Document the fair-value basis for the fee
sop: Assess whether the fee reflects fair value for the services received.
Document the basis, since sponsoring a referral source is a regulated arrangement.
Escalate where the fee cannot be justified.
Done when the fair-value basis is documented.
verify: Review the fair-value documentation against the rights schedule.
Pass when the fee has a documented fair-value basis.

steps.title: Negotiate the measurement commitments
sop: Negotiate attendance guarantees, impression counts and lead data.
Agree the reporting the organiser must supply and its timing.
Write the commitments into the agreement.
Done when the measurement commitments are in the agreement.
verify: Check the agreement for the measurement clauses.
Pass when the executed agreement lists the measurement commitments.

steps.title: Include the brand-protection terms
sop: Include approval rights over any use of our marks.
Include the right to withdraw on reputational events.
Include cancellation and refund terms.
Done when all three protections are in the draft.
verify: Locate each protection clause in the draft.
Pass when the agreement carries mark approval, withdrawal and cancellation terms.

steps.title: Complete the counterparty due diligence
sop: Run the due diligence on the counterparty and its principals.
Record the outcome and any adverse findings.
Escalate adverse findings before approval.
Done when the due diligence outcome is recorded.
verify: Open the due diligence record and check the date.
Pass when no payment is committed ahead of completed due diligence.

steps.title: Route the agreed terms for approval and execution
sop: Review the rights, fee, measurement and protection terms.
Approve or decline execution.
Record the approver, date and any conditions.
Done when execution is approved and recorded.
verify: Check the approval record against the delegated authority.
Pass when the executed agreement carries a recorded approval.

steps.title: File the executed agreement in the repository
sop: File the executed agreement with the due diligence record.
Record the sponsorship on the CRM sponsorship record.
Link the annual plan item to the contract.
Done when the executed agreement is filed and linked.
verify: Retrieve the agreement from the sponsorship record.
Pass when the executed agreement is retrievable with its due diligence record.

generic.Defined scope/population: The plan for a company-hosted event covering objective, venue, budget, invitations and owners.
generic.In-scope period: The planning window from objective setting until the plan is approved and contracted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The plan carries objective, target attendance, KPIs, budget lines and named workstream owners.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Budget lines sum to the total routed for approval before contracting.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved plan filed against the event record with approver and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Venue holds released without approval are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: The event plan and the invitation audience drawn from the CRM.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The plan fails where an opt-out contact is included in the invitation audience.
generic.Exception handling path: Budget overruns identified at planning are escalated before any contract is signed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The plan is accepted when the budget is approved and workstream owners are named.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint event folder with the approved plan and invitation audience record.

steps.title: Define the objective, audience and KPIs
sop: Define the event objective and the target audience.
Set the target attendance and the KPIs the event is measured against.
Record them on the event record.
Done when objective, attendance target and KPIs are recorded.
verify: Check each KPI can be measured from a governed source.
Pass when every KPI has a measurable source.

steps.title: Select the date, format and venue
sop: Select the date and format checking for industry and internal clashes.
Hold the venue booking pending approval.
Record the hold terms and release date.
Done when the date, format and venue hold are recorded.
verify: Run a clash check against the industry and internal calendars.
Pass when the selected date carries no unresolved clash.

steps.title: Build the budget by line and route for approval
sop: Build lines for venue, catering, AV, build, materials, speakers and travel.
Sum the lines and route the total for approval before contracting.
Record the approval decision.
Done when the budget is approved before any contract is signed.
verify: Re-add the budget lines against the approved total.
Pass when no contract is signed ahead of the budget approval.

steps.title: Build the invitation audience from the CRM
sop: Select the invitation audience from the CRM to the agreed criteria.
Apply marketing opt-out suppression before the invitation file is released.
Record the pre and post suppression counts.
Done when the invitation audience is produced post-suppression.
verify: Sample the invitation file against the opt-out list.
Pass when no contact on the marketing opt-out list is in the invitation audience.

steps.title: Plan the invitation waves and RSVP tracking
sop: Plan the invitation waves and their send dates.
Set the RSVP tracking mechanism and the target response rate.
Record the plan on the event record.
Done when the invitation plan and RSVP tracking are recorded.
verify: Check the wave plan against the target attendance.
Pass when the invited volume supports the target attendance.

steps.title: Name owners for each workstream
sop: Name owners for content, logistics, invitations and lead capture.
Set the milestone dates for each workstream.
Confirm owners accept their milestones.
Done when every workstream has a named owner and milestones.
verify: Check every workstream row for an owner.
Pass when no workstream is left without a named owner.

steps.title: File the approved plan against the event record
sop: File the approved plan with objective, budget, audience and owners.
Attach the approval record.
Release the plan to the logistics workstream.
Done when the approved plan is filed and released.
verify: Open the filed plan and check the contents.
Pass when the plan shows objective, target attendance, approved budget and named owners.

generic.Defined scope/population: All candidate sponsorship properties evaluated for selection in the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The evaluation cycle before shortlisting and contracting decisions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each candidate carries audience profile, reach, cost, dates and its criteria score.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidates evaluated reconcile to selections plus recorded rejections.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scored evaluation filed with the cycle date and the decision rationale.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Candidates rejected on reputational grounds are logged with the screening outcome.
generic.Test population: Every candidate property considered in the evaluation cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A candidate fails shortlisting where reputational screening has not been completed.
generic.Exception handling path: Properties with conflict-of-interest exposure are removed rather than conditionally shortlisted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Selection is accepted when every candidate has a score and a recorded decision.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository sponsorship evaluation folder holding the scored assessment.

steps.title: Assemble the candidate list with its facts
sop: Assemble candidates with audience profile, reach, cost and dates.
Record each property's association with our target segments.
Remove candidates outside the planning year.
Done when every candidate has a complete fact set.
verify: Check the fact set for blanks.
Pass when no candidate is missing audience, reach, cost or dates.

steps.title: Score each candidate against the published criteria
sop: Score audience fit, reach quality, brand fit, competitor presence and expected pipeline.
Apply the published criteria weightings.
Record the score and rationale.
Done when every candidate carries a score.
verify: Recompute one score from its inputs.
Pass when the recomputed score matches the recorded score.

steps.title: Screen shortlisted properties for reputational risk
sop: Screen each shortlisted property for reputational and conflict-of-interest risk.
Include any association with a regulated referral relationship.
Record the screening outcome.
Done when every shortlisted property has a completed screening.
verify: Check the screening record against the shortlist.
Pass when no property is shortlisted without a completed reputational screening.

steps.title: Compare cost per reachable target contact
sop: Calculate cost per reachable target contact for each candidate.
Compare against the alternatives in the portfolio.
Record the comparison.
Done when every candidate carries a cost per reachable contact.
verify: Recompute one candidate's figure from cost and reach.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the recorded value.

steps.title: Record the selection decision with rationale
sop: Decide which candidates are selected.
Record the score, the rationale and the reasons for each rejection.
Record the approver and date.
Done when every candidate has a recorded decision.
verify: Count candidates against decisions recorded.
Pass when every candidate has a decision and a rationale recorded.

steps.title: File the scored evaluation in the repository
sop: File the scored evaluation with the screening outcomes.
Link it to the annual event and sponsorship plan.
Record the cycle date.
Done when the evaluation is filed and linked.
verify: Retrieve the evaluation from the plan link.
Pass when the filed evaluation shows scores and decisions for every candidate.

steps.title: Hand the selections to terms negotiation
sop: Hand the selected properties to the negotiation step.
State the approved budget ceiling for each.
Confirm nothing proceeds outside the approved plan.
Done when the selections are handed over with their budget ceilings.
verify: Compare the handover list to the approved plan.
Pass when no selection outside the approved plan proceeds to negotiation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The suppression rule set configured on the campaign before the audience is armed.
generic.In-scope period: The configuration window before campaign arming, using current suppression sources.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each attached rule records its source list, refresh date and active status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dry-run suppression counts by rule reconcile to the expected volumes within tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Suppression configuration locked and stored with the lock timestamp and approver.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rules returning zero removals where removals were expected are logged and investigated.
generic.Test population: The loaded campaign audience passed through the dry-run suppression pass.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Configuration fails where an opted-out or do-not-contact record survives the dry run.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed dry run blocks arming until the rule configuration is corrected and re-run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Configuration is accepted when all required rules are active and the config is locked.
generic.Evidence location: Marketing automation platform suppression configuration record on the campaign.

steps.title: Attach the opt-out and do-not-contact rules to the campaign
sop: Attach the global opt-out, channel unsubscribe and SMS STOP lists as active rules.
Attach the internal do-not-contact list.
Record the source and refresh date of each list.
Done when all four suppression sources are attached and active.
verify: Check each attached rule shows an active status.
Pass when every required opt-out and do-not-contact rule is active.

steps.title: Enable the ineligibility suppressions
sop: Enable suppression for unlicensed states and excluded employee populations.
Enable deceased flags and open complaint or litigation status.
Record which ineligibility rules apply to this campaign.
Done when every applicable ineligibility rule is enabled.
verify: Compare enabled rules to the campaign's product and state scope.
Pass when every applicable ineligibility suppression is enabled.

steps.title: Enable the frequency-cap suppression
sop: Enable the frequency cap so contacts at the period touch limit are excluded.
Confirm the cap counts touches across all in-flight campaigns.
Record the cap setting.
Done when the frequency cap is active and cross-campaign.
verify: Test a contact already at the limit in another campaign.
Pass when the capped contact is excluded automatically.

steps.title: Run the dry run against the loaded audience
sop: Run the suppression dry run against the loaded audience.
Record the counts removed by each rule.
Investigate rules returning zero removals where removals were expected.
Done when the dry run produces counts for every active rule.
verify: Compare the counts by rule against expected volumes.
Pass when every rule's removal count sits within the expected tolerance.

steps.title: Verify no opted-out record survives the dry run
sop: Sample the surviving audience against the opt-out and do-not-contact sources.
Investigate every match found.
Correct the configuration and re-run where a match is found.
Done when the sample check returns no surviving suppressed record.
verify: Repeat the sample check after any correction.
Pass when no opted-out or do-not-contact record survives the dry-run pass.

steps.title: Lock the suppression configuration
sop: Lock the configuration so it cannot be edited without approval.
Record the lock timestamp and the approver.
Confirm the lock holds through campaign arming.
Done when the configuration is locked and recorded.
verify: Attempt an edit on the locked configuration.
Pass when the configuration rejects edits without an approval.

steps.title: Record the suppression evidence on the campaign record
sop: Attach the dry-run counts and the sample check result to the campaign record.
Attach the list refresh dates for each source.
Confirm the evidence is retrievable for audit.
Done when the suppression evidence is filed against the campaign.
verify: Retrieve the suppression evidence from the campaign record.
Pass when the filed evidence shows active rules and dry-run counts by rule.
